items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Having assumed human substance as Lover of mankind by nature, O Divine Word, Thou didst shine forth the Trinitarian, most sovereign Light of the one Godhead, showing forth the most pure Virgin who bore Thee to be glorified by all.[^58]

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: *Heirmos: He Who brought all things out of nothing...*

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Commanding of old that water be poured three times upon the wood, Elijah figuratively proclaimed the Trinitarian hypostasis of the sole Divine Sovereignty.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: The corruptible nature of the earthborn hymns Thee, the one thrice-radiant Creator, the un-

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: changeable One; and I cry unto Thee, O Master: Deliver me from every sudden destruction, and save me!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Echoing in harmony the words of the prophets, the most wise apostles, and the preachers of the faith, we the faithful glorify Thee as the equally operative Trinity, O God of all.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Descending from the high throne, taking man upon Himself as Lover of mankind through thee, O most pure one, the Word shone forth the thrice-personal Light upon all.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: O undivided and inseparable Trinity, have mercy on us who worship Thee, who piously hymn Thee, and who ceaselessly cry unto Thee: Save those whom Thou hast gathered in Thy holy Church, O Mother of compassions, to glorify Thy dominion; for as merciful, Thou knowest the weakness of our heart.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: I am wholly changed through mine intemperance and senseless lack of fear; insensible, wretched, I do not tremble before the day at which all things visible and invisible tremble. O Sovereign Lady, help me and dispel the perplexity of my heart; for thou art the hope and protectress of thy servants.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: *Heirmos: Thou hast set firm love toward us: the...*

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: A two-fold branch from the Father, as from a root, sprang forth the Son and the upright Spirit: co-natural shoots, planted by God, and co-unoriginate flowers; so that there are three luminaries of the Godhead.[^59]

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: The assemblies of intellectual beings ceaselessly hymn Thee, the unsearchable God; and with them we also glorify Thee, saying: O supra-essential Trinity, preserve Thy servants, as Thou art compassionate!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Thou hast inflamed us with love for Thee, O most merciful Word of God, Who for our sake wast incarnate without change, and mystically didst reveal the thrice-radiant, one Godhead; therefore we glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: As Isaiah figuratively beheld God, the one Sovereign Lord, glorified in three Persons with most pure voices, a Seraph was sent straightway to proclaim the thrice-radiant Essence and the thrice-personal Unity.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: O thrice-personal Unity, Who didst formerly compose the nature of things invisible and visible out of non-being: deliver from all temptations those who faithfully hymn Thee as the one God, and make them worthy of Thy glory!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Having become a radiant and pure bridal chamber for God, O Virgin,

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: we hymn thee with love and bless thee; for from thee Christ was born in dual substances and wills, Who is the only-begotten of the Father, and the Lord existing in glory.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Abraham, being a sojourner, was accounted worthy figuratively to receive the supra-essential Lord in three Persons, under human appearances.[^60]

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Direct the hearts of Thy servants unto the unapproachable Light, O thrice-personal Lord; and grant unto our souls the radiance of Thy glory, that we may be illumined by Thine ineffable beauty.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Open unto me the gates of the Light, Who was born from thy most pure womb; that beholding the radiant beam of the Godhead, I may glorify thee, the

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: all-radiant Sovereign Lady.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: When Thou shalt come upon the earth, O Master, to judge all whom Thou didst fashion from the earth according to Thine own image: show pity as Thou art merciful, and deliver all from Thy bitter judgment, and send us not into the fire of Gehenna, as Thou alone art abundantly merciful, O Christ.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Grant me sighing, O Virgin, as to the publican, and tears as to the harlot; that offering these unto thee, I may cry: Have mercy on me, O all-merciful one, and crush my perplexity by thy grace, pouring forth upon me a shower of compunction; for unto thee have I fled, O most pure one.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: *Heirmos: As of old Thou didst bedew the three...*

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Show me forth, O Master, as a temple of Thy Godhead, of Thy thrice-radiant light, having been darkened by grievous sin and passions;

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: by Thy light-giving splendors, O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: We proclaim one aspect of the Godhead in three hypostatic and distinct properties: of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Spirit; crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^61]

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: The Creator of all appeared on earth, having become man in divine manner from thy virginal, most pure womb, and He deified us. Blessed art thou, all-pure one, most pure Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: The Son and the Spirit, existing co-unoriginate with the unoriginate Father as from a root, like an offshoot of the supra-essential Divinity, have shown forth the one glory and power of the Trinity, which all of us, the faithful, hymn unto the ages.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Thou dost direct the heavenly ranks by Thy splendors,

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: to sing ceaselessly with thrice-holy divine hymns unto the Father, the Word of one form, and the Spirit: a thrice-radiant and equal-powered dominion; therefore we hymn Thee unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Beholding thy childbearing from afar, the prophetic proclamations praised it, O Mother of God; for without seed, and beyond nature, the Master was born; and in unison we sing unto Him as Lord, and we honor thee who didst bear Him, O Virgin, unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: *Heirmos: A new wonder and God-befitting: for through the...*

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Desiring to behold the thrice-radiant glory, the God-beholding ranks of the bodiless hosts manifestly desire to ascend on high with immaterial wings; yet they stand in deep awe before the unapproachable Light, and ceaselessly sing a hymn; and in unison with them, we glorify Thee, O single Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: With insatiable love, we who are upon the earth, having received from Thee an intellectual and rational soul, hymn Thee from the whole heart, O Master, God Almighty: one Nature in truth and three Persons. Therefore, O compassionate One, preserve us as Thou art almighty!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Show me forth, O Beholder of light, as a temple of Thy sovereign and thrice-radiant Godhead, that I may purely serve Thee, the Creator of all, and intellectually behold Thine ineffable glory, through the prayers of the only Mother of God, whom we worthily magnify as most glorious.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: *At "God is the Lord", the Resurrection Troparion, Tone 3: "Let the heavens be glad..." and its Theotokion, written at Saturday Vespers.*

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Christ is risen from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep, the firstborn of creation, and Maker of all[^62]

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: that has come into being; He has renewed in Himself the corrupted nature of our race. No longer dost thou reign, O death; for the Master of all has destroyed thy dominion.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: The heavenly hosts rejoiced with love, and the earthly hosts trembled with dread, when the most pure voice came upon thee, O Mother of God; for one festival shone forth upon them both, when the bodiless angel brought joy unto thee. Therefore with the angel we cry unto thee: Rejoice, pure one, dwelling-place of God!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Tasting death in the flesh, O Lord, Thou didst cut short the bitterness of death by Thy rising; and Thou didst strengthen man against it, recalling him by the overcoming of the first curse. O Defender of our life, Christ God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: The incomprehensible and uncircumscribable One, consubstantial

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: with the invisible Father, thou didst mystically contain in thy womb, O Mother of God; knowing one and unconfused Godhead from the Father, we have learned to glorify thy childbearing in the world. Therefore we also cry unto thee in thanksgiving: Rejoice, full of grace!

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Astonishing in appearance, moistening with speech, the flashing angel said unto the Myrrh-bearing women: Why seek ye the Living One in the tomb? He is risen, emptying the graves! Understand the unchangeable Changer of corruption! Say unto God: How terrible are Thy works! For Thou hast saved the human race.[^63]

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: Thou didst deliver the captivity of Zion from Babylon: draw me also, O Word, from the passions into life.

items.slavonic_text: И́же земны́ѧ сла́дости невозлю́блше стра-
items.english_text: They that sow divine tears in the south wind shall reap

items.slavonic_text: кла́сы ра́достіи , при́снѡ живо́тныѧ .
items.english_text: sheaves of joy, continually life-bearing.

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃о́мꙋ дх҃ꙋ всѧ́ко бл҃годаре́ніе , ꙗ҆́кѡже
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ сн҃ꙋ соѡблне́таетъ , и҆́мже всѧ́че
items.english_text: Unto the Holy Spirit is every thanksgiving; even as unto the Father and the Son He shines forth together, in Whom all things live and move.[^64]

items.slavonic_text: скаѧ живꙋ́тъ и҆ дви́жатсѧ . А҆нтифѡ́ , в҃ .
items.english_text: Except the Lord build the house of the virtues, in vain do we labor; and when He shelters the soul, none of us shall destroy our city.

items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще не гдⷭ҇ь сози́ждетъ до́мъ добродѣ́те
items.english_text: Of the fruit of the womb, by the Spirit, as adopted sons in Christ, even as the Holy Fathers are, ever [doth one bear].

items.slavonic_text: леи , всу́е трꙋжда́емсѧ : дш҃ꙋ́же покрыва́
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: юще . ни є҆ди́нъ же на́съ разори́тъ гра́дъ .
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is every foresight, all-various wisdom; for He enriches every creature: let us serve Him, for He is God, even as the Father and the Word.

items.slavonic_text: Пло́да чре́внаго дх҃омъ , снотворе́нном
items.english_text: Blessed are they that fear the Lord, walking in the way of His commandments; for they shall eat the life-bearing fruit of all [good things].

items.slavonic_text: ти сл҃хѣ . ꙗ҆́кѡже ѿц҃и ст҃іи всегда̀ сꙋ́тъ .
items.english_text: Rejoice, beholding around thy table thy offspring, O Chief Shepherd, bearing branches of good deeds for ever.

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́мъ дх҃омъ , прови́днѧѧ всѧ́ка всѧ́кꙋ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: ни премꙋ́дрость : богати́тъ бо всѧ́кꙋ
items.english_text: Through the Holy Spirit is all the wealth of glory, from Whom comes grace and life unto every creature; for with the Father and with the Word do we praise Him.

items.slavonic_text: тва́рь : томꙋ̀ послꙋ́жимъ бг҃ъ бо : ꙗ҆́коже
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 3:* Say among the nations that the Lord reigneth.

items.slavonic_text: Боѧ́щіисѧ гдⷭ҇а бл҃же́ни , вопꙋ́ть ходѧ́ще
items.english_text: He Who of old by divine beckoning gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, most glorious is He; let us sing unto Him alone, for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: заповѣ́дей , снѣ́дѧтъ живо́тно бо всѧ́
items.english_text: He Who condemned the earth unto the transgressor, thereafter to bring forth the fruit of thorns, hath received from the thorn a crown from lawless hands; this is our God, Who hath taken flesh; He hath dissolved the curse, for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆́крестъ тра́пезы твое́ѧ , возвесели́сѧ
items.english_text: A Victor with triumph over death, He was revealed as conquering death; for in an animate flesh He accepted suffering; this is our God, Who contended with the tyrant, and raised all with Himself, for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: зрѧ̀ свои́хъ ти , па́стыремъ нача́лниче ,
items.english_text: All nations glorify thee as the true Mother of God, who without seed gavest birth; for descending into thy sanctified womb, this is our God, Who hath shared our communion, and God and Man was born of thee.[^65]

items.slavonic_text: исча́діе носѧ́ща вѣ́ка , бл҃годѣ́ѧніа .
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃ы́мъ дх҃омъ , всѧ́ко бога́тство сла́вы ,
items.english_text: Let us sing a new song, O ye peoples, unto Him that was born of the Virgin for our salvation, and hath united earthly things with heavenly: for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: ѿне́гоже бл҃гть и҆ живо́тъ всѧ́кои тва́
items.english_text: The human race, enslaved by the sin-loving tyrant, Christ hath redeemed with His divine blood,

items.slavonic_text: ри . со ѿц҃емъ бо пое́мъ є҆го̀ и҆ со сло́вомъ .
items.english_text: and having deified it, hath renewed it: for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: Проки́меⷩ , глаⷭ҇ г҃ . Рцы́те во ꙗ҆зы́цехъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Гдⷭ҇ь во
items.english_text: As mortal, willing death, He that is the treasury of life, Christ, tasted [death]; as being immortal by nature, He hath made the dead alive: for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: цр҃исѧ . Ст҃хъ . Воспо́ите гви пѣ́нь но́вꙋ . Всѧ́ко ды
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: ха́ніе . Ст҃хъ . Хвали́те бг҃а во ст҃ы́хъ є҆гѡ̀ .
items.english_text: Every nature of the heavenly hosts bows the knee, O Virgin, unto Him Who was incarnate of thee, together with earthly beings, and worthily the nethermost: for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: Канѡ́нъ воскре́сенъ . Гла́съ . г҃ . Пѣ́снь а҃ , І҆рмо́съ .
items.english_text: O the transformation that took place in thee! For as the ungrudging Giver of good things, as God, He that gave us the divine Spirit hath taken flesh from thee, O Maiden: for He is glorified.

items.slavonic_text: Иже во́ды дре́вле , ма́ніемъ бж҃твеннымъ ,
items.english_text: He Who by the Word brought all things out of non-existence

items.slavonic_text: во є҆ди́но со́нмище совокꙋпѝ , и҆ раздѣ
items.english_text: being built, and perfected by the Spirit: O Almighty Supreme One, establish me in Thy love.

items.slavonic_text: ли́же мо́ре їи҆лтескимъ лю́демъ . сеи бг҃ъ
items.english_text: By Thy Cross the ungodly one was put to shame; for he made a pit, and fell into that which he digged; but Christ hath lifted up the horn of the humble in His Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: на́шъ , препросла́вленъ є҆́стъ . того̀ є҆ди́наго
items.english_text: The preaching of piety unto the nations, O Lover of mankind, covered the sea like water; for risen from the tomb, Thou hast revealed the Tri-hypostatic Light.

items.slavonic_text: Иже зе́млю ѡ҆сꙋди́въ престꙋпи́вшемꙋ , по
items.english_text: Most glorious things were spoken of thee, O animate city of the ever-reigning King; for through thee, O Lady, God hath dwelt together with those on earth.

items.slavonic_text: то́мъ и҆знестѝ пло́да те́рніе : ѿ те́рніа вѣ́
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: нецъ и҆з рꙋкѝ безако́нныѧ . сеи бг҃ъ нш҃ъ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast broken the bow of the enemy, and crushed the shield by Thy might, O Master Christ, our confirmation: holy art Thou, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Purity art thou, O most pure Cross, unto idolatrous impurities; for the most divine Lord hath stretched out His hands upon thee.[^66]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Let all us faithful servants worship thee, O God-receiving tomb; for in thee was buried and arose Christ, truly our God.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: A rod from the root of Jesse, having prophetically budded forth, O Virgin, Christ hath shone forth upon us as a blossom from thee: holy art Thou, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: That Thou mightest make the earthborn partakers of the divine nature, taking our flesh from the Virgin, Thou didst become poor: holy art Thou, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast shown toward us steadfast love, O Lord; for Thine Only-begotten Son Thou didst give unto death for our sake. Therefore we cry unto Thee, praising: Glory to Thy power!

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Stripes and wounds, O Christ, Thou didst mercifully endure, bearing the insult of blows and patiently enduring spitting, through which Thou hast wrought my salvation: Glory to Thy power, O Lord![^67]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: With a dying body, O Life, Thou didst partake of death, because of the misery of the poor and the sighing of the needy; and having corrupted the corrupter, glorified, Thou didst raise all: [Glory to Thy power, O Lord!]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Remember, O Christ, the flock which Thou hast purchased with Thy passion, accepting the intercessory prayers of Thy most glorious Mother; and visiting those who are afflicted, deliver them by Thy power.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Hearing the strange and ineffable mystery of Thy birth, I was afraid, and rejoicing I cried unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: O Lover of mankind, Who didst create man according to Thine image, and when he was put to death for the sin of transgression,

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: crucified upon the Place of the Skull, Thou didst save him.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The dead whom death had swallowed up it gave back, and the corruptive kingdom of Hades was destroyed, when Thou didst rise from the tomb, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: O pure Mary, golden censer, God the Word, incarnate without confusion of thee as One of the Trinity, hath filled the world with sweet fragrance.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: O Master, Who didst weigh the mountains with the measure of divine understanding, Thou wast cut off as a stone from the Virgin without hands: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast healed our diseased nature, O Master; this swift choir from the Virgin united [with us], by Thy precious Divinity, O Word.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou art my portion, O Lord, and my desired inheritance, Who hast united me from the Virgin, O Word, with Thy Hypostasis, having become a hypostasis in the flesh.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Unto Thee I rise early, the Creator of all, Who passest all understanding of peace; for a light are Thy commandments, wherein do Thou direct me.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Being delivered up through Jewish envy unto an unjust judge, the All-seeing One, Who judgeth all the earth justly, Thou didst deliver ancient Adam from condemnation.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Grant Thy peace unto Thy churches, O Christ, by the unconquerable power of Thy Cross, Thou Who art risen from the dead; and save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: A holy tabernacle and more spacious than the heavens wast thou revealed, O only ever-virgin Maiden, having received the Word of God, Whom all creation cannot contain.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Upon earth the Invisible One appeared, and with men willingly the Incomprehensible One lived; and rising early unto Thee, we sing of Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: By the piercing of Thy side with a spear, O my Christ,

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast set free from the curse that which was fashioned from man's rib, which had become the mediator of total ruin for all men.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Being equal to the Father in essence, O Savior, Thou hast raised from the dead the sacred temple of Thine all-pure and all-honorable body, O Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The Word of God is thy Son, O Virgin: the Maker of Adam the first-formed, not a creature, even though from thee He created for Himself an animate flesh.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Equal to the Father is thy Son, O Virgin: the Word of God, a perfect Hypostasis, in two natures, Jesus the Lord: perfect God and Man.[^68]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The uttermost abyss of sins hath encompassed me, and my spirit fails; but stretching out Thine high arm, O Master,

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: as Peter, O Pilot, save me.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: An abyss of mercy and compassions hath encompassed me by Thy merciful condescension; for having taken flesh, O Master, and being in the form of a servant, Thou didst deify it, and glorify it with Thyself.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: He that slays, accepted being slain, seeing him that was slain revived: these, O Christ, are the tokens of Thy Resurrection, and the victories of Thine all-pure sufferings.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: O all-pure one, who beyond understanding art the only Mediatress between the Creator and men: remember to make thy Son merciful unto thy sinful servants, and a helper.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Jonah in the nethermost parts of Hades became a type of natural likeness; he cried: Bring up my life from corruption, O Lover of mankind![^69]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: By wounds having ransomed [us], Thou hast lifted up the destruction of Hades by the Passion of the Cross; therefore I cry: Bring up my life from corruption, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The gates of Hades open unto Thee in fear, O Christ, as Thou despoilest the vessels of the enemy; therefore the women met Thee, receiving joy instead of sorrow.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: He Who is inseparably formed, hath taken form in substance and likeness for our sake from the incorrupt Virgin: the Lord, unchangeable in Divinity.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: From the abyss of sins and the storm of passions deliver me, O most pure one; for thou art a haven and an abyss of wonders unto them that flee unto thee with faith.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: As of old Thou didst refresh the three pious youths in the Chaldean furnace with the light-

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: bearing fire of Divinity, do Thou illumine us also who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^70]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The bright veil of the Temple was rent at the crucifixion of the Creator, revealing the hidden scripture truly unto the faithful who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: By Thy pierced side, with drops of God-flowing, life-creating blood, O Christ, dripping upon the earth by Thy dispensation, Thou hast renewed those that are upon earth, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Let us glorify the Good Spirit with the Father and the Only-begotten Son, honoring, O faithful, the one Beginning in three, the one Godhead, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The proud tyrant became a laughing-stock unto the youths;

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: for trampling underfoot the sevenfold flame like dust, they sang: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Beholding not a mere man hanged upon the Cross, but God incarnate, the sun was darkened; unto Whom we also sing, crying: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Frightened Hades, having received Him Who is strong in Divinity, the Giver of incorruption, spewed forth the souls of the righteous, who cried: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: An inexhaustible treasury didst thou become, O blessed and all-pure one, unto those that confess thee with a pure heart, O Mother of God; for from thee God the Word became incarnate: [Blessed art Thou, O God] of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: He Who is the Lord of glory and ruler of the higher hosts, Who sitteth with the Father, and with virginal ha-

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: nds borne: we bless Thy childbearing, O blessed Virgin.[^71]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Fierce was death, but partaking of it, Thou hast destroyed it; since from the Virgin flesh was united unto God, we cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: We all have known thee as having borne God; for the Only-begotten from the Father, incarnate, thou hast brought forth from thyself: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O all-pure one!

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: United in the unstable fire, the youths who stood for piety, unharmed by the flame, sang the divine hymn: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The brightness of the Temple was rent when Thy Cross was set up upon the Skull; and creation bowed down in fear, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Risen from the tomb, O Christ, Thou hast set upright by Thy divine power him that fell through the ancient deception, as he cries and says: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: An animate temple of God wast thou revealed, a receptacle and ark; for thou, O most pure Mother of God, dost reconcile the Creator unto men, and worthily all works glorify thee, who wast preserved a virgin after childbirth.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The God-bearing youths quenched the flame of material fire with that which is immaterial; they sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The Passionless Word, being impassibly

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: in Divinity, God suffers in the flesh; unto Whom we also sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou didst fall asleep as mortal, and didst arise as immortal, O Savior, and savest from death them that seek Thee: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Piously do we worship the Tri-hypostatic Divinity, ineffably united, and we sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: The noetic ranks, as Mother, thou hast surpassed, having drawn near unto God: We bless, O blessed Virgin, thy childbearing, and exalt it above all unto all ages.[^72]

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast displayed an eminent natural beauty, flashing forth the flesh of the Godhead,

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: O pure Virgin: therefore we sing of thee unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: A new wonder, and worthy of God! For through the shut virginal door manifestly passes the Lord, naked at His entry, and appearing as flesh-bearer at His exit is God, and the door remains shut: thee unceasingly, as Mother of God, do we magnify.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Dread is it to behold Thee, the Creator, lifted up upon the Tree, O Word of God, God suffering in the flesh for His servants, and lying breathless in the tomb, yet destroying Hades and the dead: therefore Thee, O Christ, as Almighty do we magnify.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: From mortal corruption Thou hast saved the forefather, O Christ, being laid dead in the tomb; Thou hast blossomed forth life, raising the dead,

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: having brought corruptible nature to light, and clothed it in divine incorruption: therefore Thee, the Fountain of ever-living Light, do we magnify.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: He that was ineffably and unchangeably incarnate of thee, God, showed thee forth as a receptacle of Light, O pure one; He lifted up Adam's nature upon the Cross, having become the firstborn from the dead; and He remains God in the highest, together with the Father and the Divine Spirit glorified.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Wounded with the sweet arrow of thy most pure childbirth, O pure one, and marveling at thy most amiable beauty, with angelic hymns worthily, as Mother of God, do we magnify thee.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Honor unto men from dishonorable death

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast poured forth unto all, Who through Thy crucifixion, O Savior, receiving [it] in mortal nature, didst grant me incorruption as God, O Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast saved me, O Christ, having risen from the tomb, and having ascended, Thou didst bring [me] unto the Father, Thy Begetter; and having renewed [me] at His right hand, for the tender compassion of Thy mercy, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: *Canon of the Most Holy Mother of God, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Satiety of thy praises, O Virgin, in no wise comes upon the pious faithful; for they ever receive a desired divine and spiritual love, magnifying thee as the Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: пло́ть пріѧ́лъ є҆́стъ : клѧ́твꙋ разрѣшѝ ,
items.english_text: Thou hast given us an unashamed intercessor, her that bore Thee, O Christ; by her prayers, being merciful, Thou givest us the Spirit, O Giver of grace, Who proceeds from the Father through Thee.[^73]

items.slavonic_text: На̀ хвали́те, Стих̑и́ры Воскр҃сны . Гла́съ г҃ .
items.english_text: *On the Praises, Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: стра́шныѧ та́йны си́лꙋ * хс҃ бо сп҃съ
items.english_text: Come, all ye nations, understand the power of the awesome mystery; for Christ our Savior, Who in the beginning is the Word, was crucified for our sake, and willingly was buried, and rose from the dead to save all things: let us worship Him.

items.slavonic_text: на́шъ и҆́же и҆спе́рва сы́й сло́во * распѧ́тсѧ
items.english_text: All Thy wonders did Thy watchmen declare, O Lord; but the council of vanity filled their right hands with a bribe, thinking to conceal Thy Resurrection, which the world glorifies: have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: на́съ ра́ди, и҆ во́лею погребе́сѧ * и҆ воскр҃се
items.english_text: All things were filled with joy when they received the experience of the Resurrection; for Mary Magdalene came unto the tomb and found an angel sitting upon the stone, shining in his garments and saying: "Why seek ye the Living among the dead? He is not here, but is risen, even as He said, going before you into Galilee."[^74]

items.slavonic_text: и҆зме́ртвыхъ * є҆́же сп҃сти всѧ́ческаѧ, то
items.english_text: In Thy light, O Master, Lover of mankind, we shall see light; for Thou art risen from the dead, granting salvation unto mankind, that all creation may hymn Thee, the only Sinless One: have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: Повѣ́даша всѧ̀ чꙋдеса̀, стра́жіе твоѝ гнⷭ҇и *
items.english_text: A morning hymn did the myrrh-bearing women bring unto Thee with tears, O Lord; for having scents of sweet fragrance, they reached Thy tomb, striving to anoint Thy most pure body. But an angel, sitting upon the stone, proclaimed glad tidings unto them: "Why seek ye the Living among the dead? For having despoiled death, He is risen as God, granting great mercy unto all."

items.slavonic_text: но собо́ръ сꙋ́етныхъ и҆спо́лни мздо́ю де
items.english_text: The angel shining at Thy life-bearing tomb said unto the myrrh-bearing women: "The Crucified hath emptied the tombs, and hath overthrown Hades, and is risen on the third day, as the only God and Almighty."

items.slavonic_text: сни́ца и҆́хъ * сокры́ти мнѧ́ще воскресе́ніе
items.english_text: Mary Magdalene came on the first day of the week seeking Thee in the tomb; and finding Thee not, she wailed with weeping, crying: "Woe is me, my Savior, King of all! How hast Thou been stolen?" But the pair of life-bearing angels inside the tomb cried out: "Why weepest thou, O woman?" She said, "I weep because they have taken my Lord from the tomb, and I know not where they have laid Him." But turning back, when she saw Thee, she immediately cried out: "My Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.slavonic_text: твоѐ * є҆́же мі́ръ сла́витъ: помилꙋ́й на́съ .
items.english_text: The Jews enclosed Life in the tomb; but the thief opened paradise with his tongue, crying and saying: "He Who with me and for my sake was crucified, hanging with me upon the tree, and Who appears sitting upon the throne with the Father, He indeed is Christ our Savior, Who possesses great mercy."[^75]

items.slavonic_text: Ра́дости всѧ̀ и҆спо́лнишасѧ * воскресе́ніа
items.english_text: O Christ, when our forefather Adam rejected Thy commandments, Thou didst expel him from paradise; but the compassionate thief who confessed Thee upon the cross, Thou didst settle therein as he cried: "Remember me, O Savior, in Thy kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: и҆скꙋ́съ пріе́мши * мр҃іа бо магдалы́ни ко
items.english_text: When Thou wast crucified, O Christ, all creation was visibly altered, beholding Thee, its Master, in human nature; therefore with the thief it cried: "Remember me when Thou comest in Thy kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: гро́бꙋ пріи́де * и҆ ѡ҆брѣ́те а҆́гг҃ла на̀ ка́мени
items.english_text: Having sinned, Thou didst condemn us by the curse of death, O our God, the Giver of life; yet having suffered in Thy body, O Lord, Thou hast made alive the dead man as he cries: "Remember us in Thy kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: сѣдѧ́ща * ри́зами блиста́ющасѧ и҆ гл҃юща *
items.english_text: Moses, having stretched forth his hands upon the mountain, prefigured the Cross and conquered Amalek; and we the faithful, having received it as a mighty weapon against demons, cry out faithfully: "Remember us, O Savior, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: что̀ и҆́щете жива́го соме́ртвыми * нѣ́сть здѣ̀,
items.english_text: Risen from the dead, by Thy resurrection Thou hast raised us with Thyself from passions, O Lord; and Thou hast destroyed all the power of death, O Christ; therefore in faith we cry aloud: "Remember us in Thy kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: но воста̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ речѐ * преварѧ́ѧ вы̀ во галїле́и .
items.english_text: Unto the myrrh-bearing women Thou didst first appear, having risen from the dead, O Savior, crying out: "Rejoice!" and through them proclaiming Thy rising unto Thy friends, O Christ; therefore in faith we cry aloud: "Remember us, O Savior, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom!"

items.slavonic_text: Восвѣ́тѣ твое́мъ влⷣко * оу҆́зримъ свѣ́тъ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.*

items.slavonic_text: чл҃колю́бче * воскре́се бо и҆зме́ртвыхъ * сп҃се́
items.english_text: Unto the Father, and to the Son, and to the Divine Spirit do we the faithful bow,

items.slavonic_text: ніе ро́дꙋ чл҃ческому дарꙋѧ * да тѧ̀ всѧ̀
items.english_text: unto the Uncreated Trinity in three Persons and in one Godhead, Who is continually and faithfully glorified in three sanctifications by the bodiless powers.

items.slavonic_text: тва́ръ пѣ́сносла́витъ * є҆ди́наго безгрѣ́
items.english_text: *Both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: шнаго: помилꙋ́й на́съ . И́ны Ст҃ры, восто́чны .
items.english_text: Rejoice, O gate of God, through which the Creator passed incarnate, keeping thee sealed! Rejoice, O light cloud bearing Christ the divine rain! Rejoice, O throne and heavenly ladder! Rejoice, O mountain of God unhewn!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь оу҆́тренню мѵроно́сица жены̀ * со
items.english_text: *On Sunday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 3.*

items.slavonic_text: слеза́ми приноша́хꙋ гдⷭ҇и * бл҃гоꙋха́ніа
items.english_text: As one who sins exceedingly and grieves Thee, my good Master, merciful by nature: receive me returning as the Prodigal, and make me as one of Thy hired servants, O faithful Father.[^76]

items.slavonic_text: бо во́нѧ и҆мꙋ́ще * гро́ба твое́го дости́г
items.english_text: Through worldly sloth I have exceeded all measure, and already I, the wretched one, have drawn near unto the end, not considering the judgment awaiting me and the falling away from God; but turning me back, O Savior, snatch me from all these things.

items.slavonic_text: ше * прчⷭ҇тое тѣ́ло твоѐ пома́зати тща́
items.english_text: From Gehenna and the gnashing of teeth deliver my humble soul, O Lord, and from every other eternal torment, O All-Good One; that in faith I may hymn Thee, the merciful God and Lover of mankind by nature.

items.slavonic_text: хꙋсѧ * а҆́гг҃лъ же сѣдѧ̀ на̀ ка́мени тѣ́мъ
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Bodiless Angels, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: бл҃говѣстѝ * что̀ и҆́щете жива́го соме́ртвы
items.english_text: Thou didst establish the choirs of the bodiless, O Lord, showing forth the riches of Thy goodness unto all, and bringing them from non-being into being, who now praise Thy beyond-comprehension glory with unceasing voices.

items.slavonic_text: ми * смр҃ть бо плѣни́въ воскр҃се ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ *
items.english_text: Great is the splendor of Thine angels, O Christ; for being bodiless, they traverse the world, protecting churches by the strength which is from Thee, O Master, and praying unto Thee for the universe.

items.slavonic_text: Блиста́ѧсѧ а҆́гг҃лъ на гро́бѣ твое́мъ жи
items.english_text: Beholding Thy tri-hypostatic, unique beauty, the powers serving Thee reveal second lights unto those in the world, and shining in common, they impart divine radiances unto us.[^77]

items.slavonic_text: вотво́рнѣмъ * мѵроно́сицамъ гла́ше *
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: и҆стощи́въ гро́бы распны́йсѧ * и҆ спрове́ргъ
items.english_text: O most pure one who rulest over all creatures: deliver my mind, which is cruelly ruled by passions, through thy warm intercession and motherly prayer unto thy Son and God.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 3:*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: An evening hymn do we offer unto Thee, O Christ, with censer and spiritual songs: have mercy and save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Save me, O Lord my God, for Thou art salvation unto all; the tempest of passions troubles me, and the burden of mine iniquities drowns me; give me a helping hand, and lead me unto the light of compunction, as the only Merciful One and Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord, for it was planted in one place, yet works throughout the world; and it showed forth apostles from fishermen, and martyrs from the nations, that they might intercede for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: O Mother of God, intercessor for all that pray unto thee: in thee do we take courage, and in thee do we boast, and in thee is all our hope; pray thou unto Him Who was born of thee, for thine unprofitable servants.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *On Saturday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Unto Thy life-creating Cross do we unceasingly bow, O Christ, and Thy third-day Resurrection do we glorify; for thereby hast Thou renewed the decayed nature of mankind, O Almighty One, and renewed for us the ascent unto the heavens, as the only Good One and Lover of mankind.[^78]

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Thou hast annulled the condemnation of the tree of disobedience, O Savior, by being willingly nailed unto the tree of the Cross;

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: and having descended into Hades, O Mighty One, Thou hast burst asunder the bonds of death as God; therefore we worship Thy Resurrection from the dead, crying out with joy: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Thou hast shattered the gates of Hades, O Lord, and by Thy death hast Thou abolished the kingdom of death; and having freed the human race from corruption, Thou hast granted life and incorruption unto the world, and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Come, ye peoples, let us sing the third-day rising of the Savior, whereby we have been delivered from the unbreakable bonds of Hades, and have received incorruption and life, crying out: O Thou Who wast crucified and buried, and didst rise: save us by Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Angels and men, O Savior, sing of Thy third-day rising, whereby the ends of the universe have been enlightened, and we all have been delivered from the servitude of the enemy, crying out: O Life-Creator, Almighty Savior, save us by Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Thou hast shattered the gates of Hades, and crushed the bars, O Christ God, and raised the fallen human race; therefore with one accord we cry unto Thee: Risen from the dead, O Lord, glory to Thee![^79]

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: O Lord, Thy generation from the Father is timeless and co-eternal, while Thine incarnation from the Virgin is ineffable and unutterable unto men; and Thy descent into Hades was fearful unto the devil and his angels; for having trampled down death, Thou didst rise on the third day, granting incorruption unto men, and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: The Prophet David, who through thee was the forefather of God, melodiously proclaimed concerning thee unto Him that hath done great things for thee: The queen stood at Thy right hand. For God, Who was pleased without father to become man from thee, revealed thee as mother and mediatress of life, that He might recreate His own image decayed by passions, and having found the lost sheep caught by the wolf, and taken it upon His shoulders, He might bring it unto the Father, and according to His own will unite it with the heavenly powers, and save the world, O Mother of God, Christ Who possesses great and abundant mercy.[^80]

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Resurrection, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Ascending the Cross, O Lord, Thou hast wiped out our ancestral curse; and descending into Hades, Thou hast freed the eternal prisoners, granting incorruption unto the human race;

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: therefore singing, we glorify Thy life-creating and saving Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Suspended upon the tree, O only Mighty One, Thou didst shake all creation; and laid in the tomb, Thou didst raise those dwelling in the tombs, granting incorruption and life unto the human race; therefore singing, we glorify Thy third-day rising.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Lawless people, O Christ, having delivered Thee unto Pilate, condemned Thee to be crucified, showing themselves ungrateful for Thy benefits; but willingly having endured burial, by Thine own authority Thou didst rise on the third day as God, granting us unending life and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: With tears the women, having reached the tomb, sought Thee; and finding Thee not, lamenting with weeping they cried aloud, saying:

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: "Woe is us, our Savior, King of all! How hast Thou been stolen? And what place holds Thy life-bearing body?" But the angel answered them, saying: "Weep not, but go and proclaim that the Lord is risen, granting us joy, as the only Merciful One."

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Grant consolation unto Thy servants, O all-blameless one, calming the fierce assaults against us, and delivering us from every sorrow; for thee alone do we hold as a firm and unshakable foundation, and we have acquired thy protection; let us not be put to shame, O Sovereign Lady, who call upon thee; hasten unto the prayer of those that cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady, helper of all, the joy and protection of our souls!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Let us glorify the God-originating Trinity in hypostases, unique in nature, three, co-eternal, sharing one throne; and praying, let us say: Save by faith those that honor Thee.[^81]

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Anointed by the Father with the Spirit of gladness, with the God-working oil, as Son and having become Man, He hath taught the tri-hypostatic unity of the one Godhead.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Beholding the beauty of Thine unapproachable glory, O tri-hypostatic Unity, the Seraphim, unable to gaze thereon, cover themselves with their wings, and with thrice-holy hymns unceasingly glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Ineffably hast thou given birth unto the Creator of all, O most pure one, Who delivers men from the ancient curse and from mortal corruption; and through thee have we come to know the one tri-hypostatic God.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Neither by wisdom, nor by power, nor by riches:*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Power from on high didst Thou give unto Thy holy apostles, O Christ, when Thou didst send the Comforter from the Father: Thou hast revealed the one tri-hypostatic nature.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: When Thou didst appear unto Patriarch Abraham in human form, O Trinitarian Unity, Thou didst show forth the immutable dominion of Thy goodness.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: O Thou Who in three Persons art believed in as one God, visibly uncircumscribed, incomprehensible unto all: deliver our souls from every affliction.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Instructed visibly by the teachings of thy Son, we glorify the single and thrice-radiant divine Principle; and we ever bless thee, O Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: He Who alone by a beckoning and by the most pure counsel of Thy Father and the Spirit didst create all things, O most merciful Christ, didst accept crucifixion for the human race; therefore giving thanks, we hymn Thee, crying: Have mercy on Thy flock, O only Lover of mankind![^82]

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: We hymn thee, O Bride of God, Mother of Christ God, glorifying thine incomprehensible childbearing, whereby we have been delivered from the deceit of the devil and from all perils, O Sovereign Lady, Mother of God; therefore in faith we cry out: Have mercy on thy flock, O only all-hymned one!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: O super-essential Trinity, in the unity of the Godhead and Lordship, with the Seraphim we glorify Thee as an indivisible nature, as unconfused, as equally powerful: O God incomprehensible in glory!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Divided ineffably in the Persons of the Godhead, and united by the dominion of one Lordship, boundless, one, uncircumscribed, we hymn Thee, the Creator of all creation.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: The unoriginate Mind ineffably begat the Word, and the Divine Spirit proceeded with equal power; and because of them we proclaim the consubstantial Trinity, and God, the Master of all.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Seen of old typologically, the incarnation of the Word from thee was foretold, O Virgin; but later appearing unto men, He truly manifested the tri-hypostatic monarchy.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: All things were amazed:*

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: The wings of the all-effecting Godhead understood the one unapproachable essence; and the three life-originating Hypostases we hymn as equals, the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit: a co-eternal existence.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: O thrice-radiant Light of Thine essential light, shine upon me, O unique Godhead, uncreated nature, and Fountain that gives light, with every light-giving ray, that I may contemplate Thine ineffable beauty.[^83]

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: As the one true Creator of all, Upholder, all-wise Pilot, and Giver of life: we the faithful fall down before Thee, O tri-hypostatic Master, and pray: Guard those that hymn Thee!

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: Wishing to deify man who of old had decayed, whom for His goodness He had created, Thy Son, O Virgin, showing forth the image of the divine likeness, became Man from thee, and proclaimed the one tri-hypostatic divine Principle.

items.slavonic_text: а҆́да, и҆ воскр҃се тридне́вно * ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: The Father revealed sonship by voice, and the Spirit was seen when Christ was baptized; therefore we glorify the one and threefold divine Principle.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ видѣ́въ тѧ̀ трист҃ы́ми гла́сы воспѣ
items.english_text: When Isaiah beheld Thee seated upon a high throne, hymned with thrice-holy voices, he recognized the three Hypostases of the one divine Principle.[^84]

items.slavonic_text: ва́ема Ἰ҆са́їа, на высоцѣ̀ прⷭ҇тлѣ сѣдѧ́ща,
items.english_text: Show forth an exalted heart also in us Thy servants, O exalted, tri-hypostatic King, that we may clearly behold the radiant brightness of Thy glory.

items.slavonic_text: тро́ичныи позна̀ є҆дина́го бг҃онача́лїа соста́[вы] .
items.english_text: I have sinned, yet have I not departed from Thee, wretch that I am; have compassion on me, O tri-hypostatic, one venerable Godhead, and deliver me from grievous condemnation, through the supplications of the Maiden of God.

items.slavonic_text: Возвыше́но срⷭ҇це покажѝ, и҆ на́съ ра́бъ твои́[хъ]
items.english_text: Incomprehensible and unapproachable God, Who art alone by nature good and merciful, Father, Son, and all-holy Spirit: preserve and sanctify those who in faith cry aloud in Thy holy church by night and by day; and deliver us not over, O Master, unto enemies who seek our destruction. *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: высо́кїй цр҃ю трїѵ̈поста́вне, да твое́ѧ сла́
items.english_text: We Thy servants shall never cease, O Virgin, thankfully to hymn Thine acts of mercy from the heart, O Sovereign Lady, crying out and saying: O most holy Virgin, anticipate and deliver us from invisible enemies, and from perils and every threat; for thou art our protection.

items.slavonic_text: вы зримъ ꙗ҆́сно свѣ́тлость . Бг҃оро́диченъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the fiery furnace the Persian children of...*

items.slavonic_text: Согрѣши́хъ, но тебѐ не ѿстꙋпи́хъ ѡ҆ка
items.english_text: Imitating the ordered heavenly natures and the noetic ranks in right belief, all we earthborn glorify the one Godhead in three equally-active Persons.

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ́нный, оу҆щедри́ мѧ трїѵ̈поста́вне, є҆ди́но
items.english_text: The utterances of the holy prophets of old typologically showed Thee forth as the sole Creator of all ages, the ineffable God and Lord, in three God-originating Persons.

items.slavonic_text: бж҃тво чтⷭ҇ное, и҆ лю́таго мѧ̀ и҆зба́ви ѡ҆сꙋж
items.english_text: The Word, Who by essence is invisible and all-effecting, was revealed unto men as Man from the pure Mother of God, calling man to communion with Thy Godhead, O Christ.

items.slavonic_text: Сѣда́лна, Гла́съ д҃ . По́, Вознесы́йсѧ на крⷭ҇тъ .
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Spreading out his hands, Daniel:*

items.slavonic_text: Непостижи́мыи бж҃е и҆ непристꙋ́пный, и҆́же
items.english_text: O Light unique and thrice-radiant, unoriginate Essence, unfathomable Beauty: take up Thine abode in my soul, and show me forth as a luminous and pure temple of Thy Godhead, as I cry aloud: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; hymn and exalt Him above all unto all ages![^85]

items.slavonic_text: є҆ди́нъ є҆стество́мъ бл҃гъ же и҆ мл҃рдъ, ѻ҃ч҃е
items.english_text: From diverse passions, O indivisible Trinity, unconfused Unity, deliver me from the darkening of transgressions, and illumine me with Thy God-working rays, that I may behold Thy glory and hymn Thee unto the glory of the Lord.

items.slavonic_text: и҆ сн҃е и҆ дш҃е прест҃ы́й, соблюдѝ и҆ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ,
items.english_text: The super-essential Mind, the Father; and the con-formable Word; and the co-enthroned Spirit: one essence, power, and being, super-essential, ineffable, majestic Trinity in Unity: preserve Thy flock through the prayers of the Mother of God, as the only Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: и҆́же вѣ́рою вопїю́щїи воце́ркви ст҃ѣ́й твое́й,
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Let every earthborn mortal:*

items.slavonic_text: вно́щи и҆ воднѝ . И҆ непреда́ждь влдко вра
items.english_text: Unto Thee I direct all my heart and mind, and all love of both soul and body, unto my Creator and Deliverer, O Sovereign Three-Sun Light; and I cry unto Thee: Save me Thy servant from tribulations and all afflictions!

items.slavonic_text: гѡ́мъ и҆щꙋщїи на́шꙋ поги́бель . Сла́, и҆ Нн҃ѣ . Бг҃о .
items.english_text: Exalt our mind and thought unto Thee on high, and illumine us with Thy most pure radiance, O Father, Word, and Comforter, Who dwellest in unapproachable light, O Sun and light-holding Lord of glory: that we may ever glorify Thee, the one Principle, the tri-hypostatic God.

items.slavonic_text: Непремолчи́мъ прⷭ҇нѡ, дв҃о бл҃года́рнѡ во
items.english_text: One Light in three Hypostases, distinguished in Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, by Whom all creation subsists; Who descending renewed it, and rose on the third day.

items.slavonic_text: спѣва́ти ѿсе́рдца рабѝ твоѝ, твоѧ̀ мл҃ти
items.english_text: Save those that believe in Thee, O Lord, and proclaim Thine unoriginate, eternal, single essence, and the three God-originating and con-formable Persons of Thy Lordship; and make them worthy of divine glory, through the supplications of the pure Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: влчⷢ҇це, зовꙋ́ще и҆ гл҃юще: прест҃а́ѧ дв҃о
items.english_text: *At Matins, at "God is the Lord", the Resurrection Troparion, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: предварѝ, и҆ и҆зба́ви ѿврагѡвъ неви́димыхъ,
items.english_text: Having learned the radiant proclamation of the Resurrection from the angel, and having cast off the ancestral condemnation, the women disciples of the Lord boasting said unto the apostles: Death is overthrown, and Christ God is risen, granting great mercy unto the world![^86]

items.slavonic_text: и҆ бѣ́дъ и҆ всѧ́каго преще́нїа . ты́ бо є҆сѝ
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: на́ше застꙋпле́нїе . Пѣ́ з҃, І҆рмо́ . Вопе́щи а҆вра́[мстїи]
items.english_text: The mystery hidden from the ages and unknown unto angels, through thee, O Mother of God, was manifested unto those on earth: God incarnate in unconfused union, Who voluntarily accepted the Cross for our sake; and having raised up the first-fashioned man, He saved our souls from death.

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆чине́на нб҃наѧ є҆стества̀, и҆ оу҆́мныѧ чи́
items.english_text: *After the First Kathisma, Resurrection Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: нове, правосла́вно всѝ земноро́дніи по
items.english_text: Beholding the entrance of the tomb and unable to endure the angelic flame, the myrrh-bearing women marvelled in trembling, saying: Was He stolen away, Who opened paradise unto the thief? Or is He risen, Who before His passion proclaimed resurrection? Truly Christ is risen, granting life and resurrection unto those in Hades!

items.slavonic_text: дража́юще, сла́вимъ є҆ди́но бж҃тво̀, во
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: три́ехъ равнодѣ́телныхъ соста́вѣхъ .
items.english_text: Thee we magnify, O Mother of God, crying aloud: Thou art the mountain from which the stone was cut without hands, and which crushed the gates of Hades.

items.slavonic_text: Рѣ́чи ст҃ы́хъ пррⷦ҇къ тѧ̀ дре́вле ѡ҆́бразно
items.english_text: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: є҆дина́го вѣ́кѡмъ всѣ́мъ твори́телна про
items.english_text: Of Thine own will didst Thou endure crucifixion, O Savior, and mortal men laid Thee in a new tomb, Who by Word didst establish the ends of the earth; therefore was the stranger bound, and death was grievously despoiled; and those in Hades all cried out unto Thy life-bearing resurrection: Christ the Giver of life is risen, abiding unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: ꙗви́ша непрече́ннаго бг҃а и҆ гдⷭ҇а, бг҃онача́л
items.english_text: *Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

items.slavonic_text: ными тремѝ соста́вы . Бг҃оро́диченъ .
items.english_text: Joseph was amazed, beholding that which was beyond nature, and considered in mind the dew upon the fleece in thy seedless conception, O Mother of God: the bush unburnt by fire, the rod of Aaron that budded; and bearing witness as thy betrothed and guardian, he cried aloud unto the priests: A Virgin gives birth, and after childbirth remains Virgin again![^87]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же по сꙋществꙋ̀ неви́димое сло́во и҆ все
items.english_text: Forestalling the dawn of Thy most glorious resurrection, the myrrh-bearing women proclaimed unto the apostles that Christ is risen as God, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.slavonic_text: дѣ́телное, ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ чл҃кѡмъ чл҃къ,
items.english_text: *The Gradual Hymns (Anabathmoi), Tone 4. Antiphon 1:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: From my youth many passions war against me; but do Thou Thyself defend and save me, O my Savior.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Ye that hate Zion, be put to shame before the Lord; for as grass by fire shall ye be dried up.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit every soul is quickened, and by purity exalted, illuminated by the Trinitarian Unity in sacred mystery.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: I have cried unto Thee fervently, O Lord, from the depths of my soul; let Thy divine ears be attentive unto me.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Whosoever has acquired hope in the Lord is higher than all who grieve.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit stream forth the waters of grace, watering all creation unto revitalization.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Let my heart be lifted up unto Thee, O Word, and let none of the world's allurements beguile me unto weakness.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: As one has love toward his mother, with warmer affection are we indebted to love the Lord.[^88]

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: By the Holy Spirit is the wealth of divine knowledge, contemplation, and wisdom; for in Him the Word reveals all the Father's decrees.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Prokeimenon, Tone 4:* Arise, O Lord, help us, and redeem us for Thy name's sake. *Verse:* O God, with our ears have we heard. *Let every breath praise the Lord. Verse:* Praise God in His saints. *The Gospel.*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Traversing the depth of the Red Sea of old with dry feet, Israel, by the cross-wise stretched hands of Moses, overcame the power of Amalek in the wilderness.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the most pure wood of the Cross, setting right our fall, healing the ancient murder, O Master, as good and all-powerful.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: In the tomb bodily, in Hades with Thy soul as God, in Paradise with the thief, and on the throne wast Thou, O Christ, with the Father and the Spirit, filling all things, Thyself uncircumscribed.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Without seed, by the Father's will, from the divine Spirit of God thou didst conceive the Son, and in the flesh gavest birth unto Him Who from the Father was without mother, and for our sake from thee without father.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Another Canon, of the Cross and Resurrection, Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos: I shall open my mouth:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Healing the brokenness of mankind, O Lord, by this Thy divine blood Thou didst renew it, and didst shatter the one strong in might who of old had shattered Thy creation.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Resurrection came unto the dead by reason of His putting to death; for power was taken away from death, which became food unto eternal life, when God, Who rules over all, became incarnate.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Fair and exalted above the heavenly hosts was thy divine ensouled temple, O Virgin, when in thy womb thou didst carry the holy mountain of our God.[^89]

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Mother of God, the same Tone. Heirmos: The captains:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: The peoples were shaken, the nations were troubled, and mighty kingdoms yielded, O pure one, from awe at thy childbearing; for my King came, cast down the tormentor, and delivered the world from corruption.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Descending unto men, O Christ, Who dwellest on high, Thou didst sanctify Thine abode and showed it forth unshaken; for after childbirth the only Virgin vessel preserved the Creator Whom she bare.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thy church rejoices in Thee, O Christ, crying aloud: Thou art my strength, O Lord, my refuge and my firm support!

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: The living tree, the true noetic vine, hangs upon the wood, pouring forth incorruption unto all.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: How great, how awesome! He cast down the arrogance of Hades, and as incorruptible God is now risen bodily from the tomb.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thou alone upon earth wast made the mediatress of blessings beyond nature, Mother of God; therefore do we cry unto thee: Rejoice!

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Another Canon (of the Cross and Resurrection). Ode 3. Heirmos: Thy singers:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: The serpent plunged his venom-filled fangs into me, O Savior; but Thou, O Almighty Lord, didst shatter them with the nails of Thy hands; for there is none holy among the saints save Thee, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thou wast seen voluntarily in the tomb, O Lover of mankind, dead yet life-giving, and didst burst open the gates of Hades for the souls bound from the ages; for there is none holy among the saints save Thee, O Lord.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thou wast shown forth as the unplowed furrow, having brought forth the living ear of wheat, the mediator of immortality unto all who partake of Him Who rests as Holy among the saints.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Another Canon (to the Theotokos). Ode 3. Heirmos: He Who is on high:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: The essence of earthly mortals is purified, having conversed with the unendurable divine fire; for mystically, O all-pure Virgin, within thee was the Bread baked by Him Who preserved thee unharmed.[^90]

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Who is this who truly is close unto God, having surpassed the angelic ranks, shining alone through the beauty of maidenhood as the Mother of the Almighty?

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 4. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up upon the Cross, the church stood in her order, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Having tasted of the sinless and life-creating body of Thine, death was worthily put to death, O Master; and we cry aloud unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thou didst come healing my passions, when Thy most pure flesh, wherein Thou wast willingly clothed, suffered upon the Cross; therefore we cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Without knowing wedlock didst thou give birth, O Virgin, and after childbirth wast shown forth still a Virgin; therefore with frail voices, with undoubting faith, we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady!

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Another Canon (of the Cross and Resurrection). Ode 4. Heirmos: Unto the inscrutable divine counsel:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: The lawful Israel did not recognize Thee, O Christ, the God Who gave the Law; but as lawless, transgressing the law, unworthy of the legislation, nailed Thee to the Cross.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thy deified soul, O Savior, despoiled the treasuries of Hades and raised the souls bound from the ages; and Thy life-bearing body poured forth incorruption unto all.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thee, the truly ever-virgin, the only Mother of God, do we glorify: whom Moses prefigured in the bush that was mingled with fire unconsumed, O most pure one.[^91]

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Another Canon (to the Theotokos). Ode 4. The same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Bearing our corruption, the Invisible One became visible, being in the fullness of invisible Godhead, and taking form from thee, O Virgin, to save from the alien one those who know thee as the pure Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Materially the Virgin received the Immaterial One in the midst of matter, become an Infant from her; therefore is He now known in two natures: God bearing flesh, and an earthly mortal above nature.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: He Who took up His abode in thee, a virgin, after childbirth remained Word and God, born without seed; and in childbirth He preserved thee a Virgin, as Master and Creator.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: *Canon of the Resurrection. Ode 5. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
items.english_text: Thou, my Lord, art a light come into the world: a holy light turning those that hymn Thee in faith from the darkness of ignorance.

items.slavonic_text: ѿчⷭ҇тыѧ бг҃ома́тере, чл҃ка призыва́ѧ кпри
