items.english_text: The Prophet Daniel was struck with awe, beholding thee as the spiritual mountain from which the stone was cut without hands, which mightily shattered the pagan temples, O Bride of God.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: No human word or tongue can worthily praise thee, O Virgin; for of thee without seed, O all-pure one, God the Giver of life was well pleased to become incarnate.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Christ is my power, my God and Lord, the venerable Church divine-fittingly cries aloud, keeping festival in the Lord with a pure conscience.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: The tree of true life has blossomed, O Christ, and brought forth life for us; for the Cross was planted, and water and blood from Thine incorruptible side watered all things.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: No longer does the serpent falsely suggest deification unto me; for Christ, the Benefactor of human nature, has now prepared an unhindered path unto my life. *Theotokion:* [^141]

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Truly ineffable and incomprehensible to those on earth and in heaven, O Virgin Theotokos, are the mysteries of Thy divine-fitting childbearing. *Another Heirmos: Foreseeing Thy divine condescension upon the Cross...*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: He Who is co-eternal with the Father on high was nailed in the flesh upon the tree for our sake; and as all-powerful, He destroyed the curse that was in Paradise.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: The all-pure flesh of the Redeemer did not see corruption while lying in the tomb; but as all-powerful, O Christ, Thou didst shatter the bars of Hades and didst arise in glory on the third day.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Unto the myrrh-bearing women our Savior, having arisen from...

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: ...the dead, proclaimed: "Rejoice!" and cried unto them: "Go forth now and preach the glad tidings unto Mine apostles!" *Another Heirmos: Christ is my power...*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: We hymn thee, O all-pure and most immaculate one, having been saved through thee; and chanting piously, we cry: Blessed art thou who hast borne God in the flesh.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Having borne the unsetting Light, O Virgin, shining in the flesh upon those who dwell in the darkness of this life, O most blessed one, Thou hast poured out joy upon them that hymn thee, O Ever-Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Grace has blossomed and the Law has ceased because of thee, O all-pure one; for thou, O pure one, hast borne the Lord, Who ever grants us remission, O Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: The tasting of the tree of the garden showed me to be dead; but the Tree of Life that appeared from thee, O all-pure one, has brought me to life and made me an heir of the delight of Paradise. *Ode 5. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: With Thy divine light, O Good One, illumine, I pray Thee, the souls of those who dawn early unto Thee with love, to behold Thee, the Word of God, the true God, Who draws them out from the gloom of sin.[^142]

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: The cherub now withdraws from me, O Master, and the flaming sword turns its back unto me, seeing Thee, the Word of God, the true God, Who hast made a way into Paradise for the thief.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: No longer do I fear the return unto the earth, O Master Christ; for out of the earth Thou hast raised me up who was forgotten, by reason of Thy great tenderheartedness, unto the height of incorruption by Thy Resurrection. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: O good Lady of the world, save those who from the soul confess thee to be the Theotokos; for we have thee as an invincible defense, the true Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Isaiah, beholding Thy divine epiphany unto us, O Christ...*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: In Thy tenderheartedness toward us, O Good One, having taken flesh, Thou wast willingly nailed upon the cross for my sake, who of old forsook Thy holy commandment by eating in Paradise; and Thou didst die as man, bestowing life upon me.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Beholding Thee upon the throne as God, and yet numbered among the dead as mortal, Hades vomited forth those whom the wretched one held before; and on the third day, as the Mighty One, Thou didst raise fallen nature with Thyself, and Thou Thyself didst enlighten the whole world, O Christ. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Thou didst not suffer corruption in womb, having undergone childbirth like a maiden; but Thou remainest again as before, O Virgin Mother unwedded; therefore pray fervently for Thy servants who glorify thee, that they may be delivered from...

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: ...temptations and perils. *Another Heirmos: With Thy divine light, O Good One...* [^143]

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Shining from afar with purity, a divine habitation was prepared, O all-hymned Theotokos; for thou alone wast truly revealed as the Mother of God, carrying Him in Thine arms like an infant.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Bearing spiritual beauty and the preeminence of Thy soul, thou wast the Bride of God, sealed with virginity, O pure one, and enlightening the world with the light of purity.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Let the assembly of the impious lament, who do not confess thee as pure Theotokos by Thy childbearing; for thou wast shown unto us as the door of the divine Light, dispelling the cloud of sins. *Ode 6. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Beholding the sea of life surging with the tempest of temptations, fleeing unto Thy calm haven...

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: ...I cry unto Thee: Lead up my life from corruption, O Most Merciful One!

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Being crucified with nails, O Master, Thou didst blot out the curse that was against us; and being pierced in the side with a spear, having torn up the handwriting against Adam, Thou didst set the world free.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: Adam was cast down, deceived by guile into the pit of Hades; but Thou Who by nature art God and merciful didst descend to seek him, and bearing him upon Thy shoulders, didst raise him up with Thyself. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: O all-pure Sovereign Lady, who hast borne the Helmsman and Lord for those on earth, dispel the unstable and fierce turmoil of my passions, and grant stillness unto my heart.

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Jonah was held, but not held fast, in the belly of the sea monster...*

items.slavonic_text: Сора́вна и҆ сопри́сносꙋ́щна сла́вимъ , є҆дина́го тѧ̀ посꙋще́ствꙋ бг҃а , сво́йствы несли́-
items.english_text: How didst Thou endure wounds, insults, and evil slanders, O Word? For Thou wast willing as man, in the flesh...

items.slavonic_text: пло́тїю ст҃рть претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ : но̀ бг҃ъ сы́й , безстра́стенъ пребы́сть , воздвиза́емъ на́ древѣ посредѣ̀ двою̀ разбо́йникꙋ . спа́слъ же є҆сѝ є҆стество̀ на́ше ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ .
items.english_text: ...in the flesh Thou didst endure suffering; yet being God, Thou didst remain impassible, lifted up upon the tree between two thieves. And Thou didst save our nature, as all-powerful.[^144]

items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ вогробѣ́ хотя̀ положи́сѧ сп҃се менѐ ра́ди , ꙗ҆́кѡ мр҃твъ , и҆ свѣ́тъ возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ , и҆́же вотьмѣ̀ и҆ сѣ́ни сме́ртнѣй держи́мымъ ѡ҆блиста́въ тридне́вно , и҆ срѣ́тъ мѵроно́сицъ , си́це возгласи́въ тѣ́мъ , ра́дꙋйтесѧ вои́стиннꙋ , и҆ рцѣ́те про́чее а҆́плѡмъ мои́мъ .
items.english_text: Willingly laid in the tomb for my sake as dead, O Savior, Thou didst shine forth light, illuminating for three days those held fast in darkness and the shadow of death; and meeting the myrrh-bearing women, Thou didst cry aloud unto them: "Rejoice indeed, and tell the rest unto Mine apostles!" *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Ѽ дв҃о ѡ҆брадо́ваннаѧ мт҃и бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ , ты̀ и҆́же пре́жде вѣ́къ рожде́ннаго ѿ ѻ҃ца̀ безна́чална , неискꙋсобра́чно прїѧ̀ воꙋтро́бѣ , и҆ роди́ла є҆сѝ воплоще́нна . є҆го́же молѝ ѡ҆всѣ́хъ на́съ , мно́жество щедро́тъ ни́зъпосла́ти на́мъ .
items.english_text: O Virgin full of grace, Mother and Bride of God: without knowing wedlock, Thou didst receive into Thy womb Him Who was begotten of the unoriginate Father before all ages, and Thou didst bear Him incarnate; pray Him for us all, to send down the multitude of His compassions upon us.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́нъ , І҆рмо́ . Житє́йскаго мо́рѧ воздвиза́ема зрѧ̀ ·
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Beholding the sea of life surging...*

items.slavonic_text: Вели́кїй пренаписа̀ вопроро́цѣхъ мѵсе́й : тѧ̀ ковче́гъ и҆ тра́пезꙋ , и҆ свѣ́щникъ : и҆ рꙋ́чкꙋ ѡ҆́бразнѡ ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ воплоще́нїе , є҆́же ѿ тебѐ вы́шнѧго мт҃и дв҃о .
items.english_text: Great Moses among the prophets prefigured thee, typifying thee as the Ark, the Table, the Candlestick, and the Jar, revealing the incarnation from thee of the Most High, O Virgin Mother.

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мерщвлѧ́етсѧ сме́рть , и҆ тлѣ́нїе ᲂу҆пражнѧ́етсѧ , а҆да́мова ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ плодо́мъ твои́мъ преложне́ѧ Ѽ бл҃чце , живо́тъ бо роди́ла є҆сѝ , ѿ и҆стлѣ́нїѧ и҆збавлѧ́ѧ пою́щихъ тѧ̀ .
items.english_text: Death is put to death and corruption is abolished, the condemnation of Adam being overturned by Thy fruit, O Sovereign Lady; for Thou hast borne Life, delivering from corruption those who hymn thee.

items.slavonic_text: За́конъ и҆знемо́же , и҆ пре́йде сѣ́нь : вы́шше ᲂу҆ма̀ и҆ по́мысла , ꙗ҆ви́вшисѧ бл҃гти , и҆́же ѿ тебѐ дв҃о рж҃тво́мъ бг҃а и҆ сп҃са , многопѣ́таѧ .
items.english_text: The Law grew faint and the shadow passed away, when grace appeared beyond mind and thought through Thy childbearing of God and the Savior from thee, O all-hymned Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: An angel, indeed, made the furnace pour forth dew for the venerable children, but the command of God burned up the Chaldeans, persuading the tyrant to cry:

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^145]

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Lamenting Thy Passion, the sun clothed itself in darkness, and at midday the light was darkened over all the earth, O Master Christ; [and we sing:] Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: By Thy descent, O Christ, the nether regions were clothed in light; and our forefather, appearing full of joy, leaped and danced, crying aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Hymning the ruling and all-governing three-hypostatic nature of goodness, and the measureless abyss of light, we the faithful cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: An ineffable wonder in the furnace...*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The impious children of transgressors crucified Thee upon the place of the skull, Who didst shatter the brazen gates and bars; and singing for our salvation, [we cry:] Blessed art Thou, O God our Redeemer!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thou didst tear apart the dominion of death, and having arisen, Thou dost grant resurrection unto those who truly glorify Thee as Lord, and who in orthodox faith cry unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O God our Redeemer! *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thou hast borne One of the Trinity, O all-pure one, Who appeared upon earth in two natures by reason of His tenderheartedness; entreat Him unceasingly to save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The furnace did not consume the three youths, prefiguring Thy childbearing; for the divine fire dwelt within thee without consuming thee, and enlightened all to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The ends of the earth call thee blessed, O all-venerable Mother, even as thou didst foretell, being enlightened by Thy radiant beams, and shining with grace, they cry: Blessed is she who bore God in the flesh!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The all-crafty serpent indeed drove in destructive teeth into the pit; but Thy Son, O Mother of God, shattered them, granting me strength to cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers.[^146] *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thou alone, O divinely-blessed one, becamest the sanctuary of nature; for having carried in Thine arms God Who sits upon the cherubic shoulder, thou didst cry aloud: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: From the flame Thou didst pour dew upon the venerable ones, and by water Thou didst burn up the sacrifice of the righteous one; for Thou dost accomplish all things, O Christ, whatsoever Thou desirest. Supremely we exalt Him as Lord unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The Jewish people who of old were murderers of the prophets, now accomplished deicidal envy, lifting Thee up upon the cross, O Word of God; supremely we exalt Him as Lord unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Not leaving the vault of heaven, yet descending into Hades, Thou didst raise up man who lay entirely in the dung-heap, O Christ; therefore we hymn Thee unto all ages. *Trinity Hymn (Triadikon):*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The single nature of the Trinity, incalculable in might, surpassing every word and comprehension of nature, we ever orthodoxly proclaim and supremely exalt unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Be astonished, O heaven, with fear...*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Every hearing was astonished: Oh, how the Most High willingly descended upon the earth, to destroy the power of Hades by crucifixion and burial, and raised all up to cry: Children, bless; priests, praise; people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Oh, Thine ineffable condescension, O Christ, and unspeakable goodness! For seeing me perishing in the prison of Hades, suffering...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...suffering Passion, Thou didst deliver me; therefore we hymn Thee, the Master of all, and supremely exalt Thee unto all ages.[^147] *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Rejoice, O gate of God! Rejoice, unwedded one! Rejoice, wall of the faithful, O Mary! Rejoice, all-pure one! Rejoice, thou who alone didst bear God for earthly men, unto Whom we cry: Children, bless; priests, praise; people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: From the flame Thou didst pour dew upon the venerable ones...*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Having enlightened thee with the radiance of the Spirit as a queen in a gilded robe, Thy Son set thee at His right hand, O all-pure one; supremely we exalt Him as Lord unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: He Who established the world by His sole volition borrows flesh from Thine all-pure womb, desiring to create it anew from on high; supremely we exalt Him as Lord unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: For the union of the Word with me, man, a divine...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...a divine dwelling wast thou, O all-pure one, manifestly shining forth with the brightness of virginity; therefore we the faithful hymn thee unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The golden candlestick prefigured thee, who ineffably received the unapproachable Light that illuminates the ends of the earth with its radiance; therefore we hymn thee, O pure one, unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: It is impossible for mankind to see God, upon Whom the ranks of angels dare not gaze; but through thee, O all-pure one, the incarnate Word was revealed unto us, Whom magnifying, together with the heavenly hosts, we magnify thee.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thou didst remain exempt from passions, O Word of God, having shared in passions in the flesh; yet Thou dost release man from passions, having become the passion of passions, O our Savior; for Thou alone art...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...impassible and all-powerful.[^148]

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Having accepted mortal corruption, Thou didst preserve Thy body free from corruption without experiencing it; and Thy life-creating and divine soul, O Master, was not left in Hades, but having arisen as Thou didst promise, Thou didst raise us with Thyself. *Trinity Hymn (Triadikon):*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: God the Father and the Son co-unoriginate, we all born of earth glorify with pure lips; and honoring the ineffable and most glorious power of the all-holy Spirit, for one is the all-powerful, indivisible Trinity.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Weep not for me, [O Mother]...*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Though Thou didst descend into the tomb as dead, O Giver of life, yet Thou didst tear apart the might of Hades, O Christ, and didst raise with Thyself the dead whom it had previously swallowed, and as God Thou didst bestow resurrection unto all who magnify Thee with faith and love.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Let creation be made radiant, let all born of earth rejoice; for the enemy Hades has been despoiled! Christ is risen, and the first-created is raised with Him in glory, delivered from corruption!—so the angel cries aloud unto the myrrh-bearing women.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Creation rejoices with Thy childbearing, O Maiden, for it has opened Eden unto us who behold it; and having partaken of the tree of this life by faith, we cry earnestly: Fulfill our supplications, O Sovereign Lady!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: It is impossible for mankind to see God...*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: A Star shining with the beams of the Godhead from Jacob upon those held fast in gloom, through thee, O all-pure one, has shone forth: Christ God, the Word incarnate, by Whom enlightened, together with the heavenly hosts we magnify thee.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Strengthened by Thy power and grace, I have fervently offered a hymn from my heart unto thee;

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...yet accept this hymn, O pure Virgin, granting in return Thy most radiant grace from incorruptible treasures, O divinely-blessed one.[^149]

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thou wast shown to be a divinely-woven loom, O Virgin, in which the Word wove the garment of the body, making divine my form in which He clothed Himself, O Savior of all, Who savest those who magnify Thee from a pure mind.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Resurrection is now granted unto the dead by Thine unspeakable and ineffable childbearing, O all-venerable Theotokos; for Life, having clothed Himself in flesh from thee, has shone forth upon all, and manifestly destroyed the corrupt mingling of death.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *At the Praises (Lauds), the Resurrection Stichera, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, is life and resurrection unto Thy people; and trusting in it, we hymn Thee, our risen God: Have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thy burial, O Master, opened Paradise unto mankind; and delivered from corruption, we hymn Thee, our risen God: Have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: With the Father and the Spirit let us hymn Christ Who is risen from the dead, and let us cry unto Him: Thou art our life and resurrection: Have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: On the third day Thou didst arise from the tomb, O Christ, even as it is written, raising our forefather with Thyself; therefore the human race glorifies Thee and hymns Thy Resurrection.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: O Lord, great and fearful is the mystery of Thy Resurrection; for in this manner Thou didst come forth from the tomb like a bridegroom from his chamber, destroying death by death that Thou mightest set Adam free; therefore in heaven the angels dance, and upon earth...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...men glorify Thy tenderheartedness toward us, O Lover of mankind![^150]

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: O lawless Judeans: where are the seals and the silver coins that ye gave to the soldiers? The treasure was not stolen, but He arose as the Mighty One; and ye yourselves have been put to shame, having rejected Christ the Lord of glory, Who suffered and was buried, and arose from the dead! Him let us worship!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: While the tomb was sealed, how were ye despoiled, O Judeans, having set a guard and affixed seals? The King came forth while the doors were shut: either produce Him as dead, or worship Him as God, singing with us: Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Weeping, the myrrh-bearing women reached Thy life-receiving tomb, O Lord; and carrying...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...carrying myrrh, they sought to anoint Thine all-pure body; but they found a light-bearing angel sitting upon the stone, who spoke unto them, saying: "Why weep ye for Him Who poured forth life from His side unto the world? Why seek ye the Immortal One in the tomb as though He were dead? Go rather, proclaim unto His disciples His glorious Resurrection, the universal joy! Whereby enlighten us also, O Savior, and grant cleansing and great mercy!"

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Glory. The Evangelical Sticheron. And now. Most blessed art thou.*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *On Sunday, the Beatitudes (Makarismoi), Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom, and save me, as the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Adam was deceived through the tree; but through the tree of the Cross Thou didst save him again, who cries...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...who cries: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest in Thy kingdom.[^151]

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Let us hymn Christ our God, Who was willingly crucified and buried, and arose on the third day in glory.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Having shattered the gates and bars of Hades, Thou didst raise up all who were in Hades, who cry: O compassionate Savior, glory to Thy rising!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Let us all with one accord hymn Christ Who arose from the tomb as He foretold before His Passion, and Who despoiled Hades.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Having appeared as a light unto the world, the Apostles drove away all the darkness of deception by the divine beams of their teachings. *Glory:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: We glorify the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, saying: O Holy Trinity, save our souls! *And now:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Rejoice, O gate open unto God, Who ineffably...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...dwelt within thee and came forth from thee, O Ever-Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *On Sunday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Penitential Stichera, Tone 6.*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Grant tears of repentance with a contrite mind, that I may wash away the filth of my soul, which I have evilly defiled by committing unrighteous deeds at every hour, having as intercessors herein her who bore Thee, and the angelic choirs, and Thy love for mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Come, O soul, and repent of the many sins which thou hast committed in life; and pray unto the multitude of the hosts on high with sighing and tears, that time for repentance may be granted thee, lest like the barren fig tree thou be cut down into the fire of Gehenna without feeling.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Not a single commandment of Thine upon earth have I kept! How shall I appear before Thee as Thou sittest upon the throne, to give an account, when Thou executest judgment upon all for whatsoever each has committed in knowledge and in ignorance, O Christ my [God]?[^152] Therefore I cry unto Thee: By the prayers of Thy ministers, save me, the prodigal!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *Other Stichera, to the Holy Bodiless Angels, Tone 6.*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Standing before Thy throne, O Christ, the angelic hosts make supplication for the human race: by their prayers grant peace unto all, and subdue the arrogance of the nations.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Ever dancing around the throne of the King of all, all ye ranks of angels: preserve us who call upon you in faith, and deliver us from torments!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: The Father Who is God over all brought forth the powers of heavenly...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...heavenly minds, formless and immaterial, as chanters of His thrice-radiant glory, with the unique Word and the Spirit.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Having conceived in Thy womb the Word Who is co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit at the archangel's greeting, O Theotokos, thou wast revealed as higher than the Cherubim, the Seraphim, and the Thrones.

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: At Thy fearful coming, O Christ, may we not hear: "I know you not!" For we have placed our hope in Thee, O Savior, even though through our negligence we have not kept Thy commandments; but spare our souls, we pray Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: I have not acquired repentance, nor yet tears; therefore I pray Thee, O God, to turn me before the end, and grant me compunction...

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: ...that I may be delivered from torment. *Martyrion:* [^153]

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, did not deny Thee, nor did they depart from Thy commandments: by their prayers have mercy on us! *Glory, and now. Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: With archangelic voices let us the faithful hymn the heavenly chamber and truly sealed door: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady, for Whose sake Christ, the Giver of life and God, the Savior of all, sprouted forth for us! Cast down the tyrant, our godless enemies, by Thy hand, O all-pure one, the hope of Christians!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: *In the Book of the Resurrection: Tone 7.*

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Come, let us rejoice in the Lord, Who shattered the dominion of death and enlightened the human race, crying with the bodiless hosts: O our Creator and Savior, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Хладода́вцꙋ ᲂу҆́бѡ пе́щь сотворѝ а҆́гглъ , преподо́бнымъ дѣ́темъ : халде́єже ѡ҆палѝ велѣ́нїе бж҃їе . мꙋчи́телѧ ᲂу҆бѣ́йца во
items.english_text: Thou didst endure the Cross and burial for our sake, O Savior; and as God, by death Thou didst put death to death.

items.slavonic_text: ᲂу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ: тѣ́мже покланѧ́емсѧ тридне́вномꙋ воскресе́нїю твоемꙋ̀, гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: ...didst put to death: therefore we worship Thy third-day Resurrection, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: А҆́пⷭ҇ли ви́дѣвше воскресе́нїе содѣ́телѧ дивлѧ́хꙋсѧ пою́ще хвалꙋ̀ а҆́гг҃льскꙋю: сїѧ̀ сла́ва цр҃ко́внаѧ, сїѐ бога́тство црⷭ҇твїѧ, пострада́вый на́съ ра́ди, гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: The Apostles, seeing the Resurrection of the Creator, marveled, singing the angelic praise: This is the glory of the Church, this is the wealth of the Kingdom! O Thou Who didst suffer for our sake, O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще и҆ ѧ҆́тъ бы́сть хрⷭ҇то́съ ѿ беззако́нныхъ мꙋже́й, но ты́ ми є҆сѝ бг҃ъ и҆ несрамлѧ́юсѧ: бїе́нъ бы́сть по плещи́ма, и҆ не ѿмета́юсѧ: на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ пригво́здисѧ, и҆ не таю̀: воскресе́нїемъ твои́мъ хва́лю́сѧ, сме́рть бо твоѧ̀ живо́тъ мо́й, всеси́льне чл҃колю́бче гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: Though Christ was seized by lawless men, yet Thou art my God, and I am not ashamed; He was smitten upon the back, and I deny Thee not; He was nailed unto the Cross, and I conceal it not; in Thy Resurrection do I boast, for Thy death is my life: O Almighty One, Lover of mankind, O Lord, glory to Thee! [^154]

items.slavonic_text: Дв҃дское прⷪ҇ро́чество и҆сполнѧ́ѧ хрⷭ҇то́съ, вели́чествїѧ въ Сїѡ́нѣ свои̑мъ ᲂу҆че́никѡмъ ѿ[кры́лъ]
items.english_text: Fulfilling the prophecy of David, Christ revealed...

items.slavonic_text: кры́лъ є҆́стъ: хвали́ма пока́зꙋѧ себѐ, и҆ сла́вима при́снѡ со ѻ҃тце́мъ и҆ дх҃омъ ст҃ы́мъ. пе́рвѣе ᲂу҆́бѡ безпло́тенъ ꙗ҆́кѡ сло́во, послѣ́ди же на́съ ра́ди воплоще́нна и҆ ᲂу҆ме́рщвленна бы́вша ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃ка, и҆ воскре́сша со вла́стїю ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бца.
items.english_text: ...revealed His majesties in Zion unto His disciples, showing Himself praised and ever glorified with the Father and the Holy Spirit: first indeed bodiless as the Word, and afterwards for our sake incarnate and put to death as man, and risen with power as the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Соше́лъ є҆сѝ во а҆́дъ хрⷭ҇тѐ ꙗ҆́коже и҆зво́ли, и҆ спрове́рже сме́рть ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ и҆ влⷣка, и҆ воскре́се тридне́вно, совоскреси́въ а҆да́ма ѿ а҆́довыхъ ᲂу҆́зъ и҆ тлѣ́нїѧ, воззыва́юща и҆ глаго́люща: сла́ва воскресе́нїю твоемꙋ̀, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_text: Thou didst descend into Hades, O Christ, as Thou didst will; Thou didst overthrow death as God and Master, and didst rise on the third day, raising Adam with Thyself from the bonds of Hades and from corruption, as he cried out and said: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Во гро́бѣ положи́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ спѧ̀ гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ воскре́се тридне́венъ ꙗ҆́кѡ си́ленъ во крѣ́пости: совоскреси́въ а҆да́ма ѿ тлѧ̀ сме́ртныѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ъ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: The Lord was laid in the tomb as one asleep, and He arose on the third day as One mighty in strength, raising Adam with Himself from the corruption of death, as Almighty God.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou wast known as Mother above nature, O Theotokos, yet remainedst...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...remainedst a virgin above speech and understanding, and no tongue can declare the wonders of thy childbearing; for glorious being thy conception, O pure one, incomprehensible is the manner of thy giving birth: for where God so wills, the order of nature is overcome. Therefore, knowing thee as the Mother of God, we earnestly pray thee: Intercede that our souls may be saved! [^155]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Resurrection Stichera, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Risen from the tomb, O Savior of the world, Thou didst raise man with Thyself in Thy flesh: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Come, let us worship Him Who rose from the dead and enlightened all things; for He has freed us from the tyranny of Hades by His third-day Resurrection, granting us life and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Having descended into Hades, O Christ, Thou didst take death captive, and having risen on the third day, Thou didst raise us with Thyself as we cry: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou didst appear fearful, O Lord, even as Thou layest in the tomb as one asleep; but having risen on the third day as One mighty, Thou didst raise Adam with Thyself, who glorifies Thy almighty uprising, O Lord, Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Beneath thy shelter, O Sovereign Lady, all we who are born of earth flee, crying unto thee: O Theotokos, our hope, deliver us from our countless transgressions, and save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *On Sunday at the Midnight Office, Canon to the Holy and Life-Originating Trinity, Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos: By Thy beck:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Open Thou the spiritual lips of my heart and these material lips to Thy praise, O Thrice-Radiant One, unique Godhead of all, that I may sing unto Thee...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...a light-bestowing song of thanksgiving. [^156]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: That Thou mightest show forth the co-eternal power of Thy goodness, O unfathomable Trinity, Thou didst fashion man, an earthen image of Thy primordial and sovereign lordship, O Creator.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: O unoriginate Mind, Who didst beget the co-eternal Word, and didst cause the co-unoriginate Spirit to shine forth: make us worthy to worship the one God, connatural in essence and tri-hypostatic!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou didst appear unto Moses at the bush, O Word of God, as a consuming fire, yet leaving it unconsumed, prefiguring Thine incarnation from the Virgin, whereby Thou didst refashion mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: In the beginning, the heavens:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Hymning Thee as the single, thrice-radiant, and all-creative Master, we ask deliverance from sins and...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...and calamities: O Almighty God, despise not those who in faith glorify Thy goodness!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: A shoot sprouted from the Father as from an unoriginate root, God the Word, equal in power with the connatural Divine Spirit; therefore, O faithful, in Trinity of persons we glorify the single Lordship.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Equal in glory and connatural is the tri-hypostatic Godhead, indivisible and inseparable; and as the monarchical Trinity, all we the faithful doxologize Thee, and bowing down, we ask forgiveness of transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Unchangeably likened in all things unto men, O Word of God, Thou didst come forth visibly from the pure Virgin, and didst reveal unto all the thrice-radiant Godhead and single essence of the unchangeable...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...hypostases. [^157]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Have mercy, O Holy Trinity, upon Thy servants who have sinned; and accept those who repent unto Thee, O Compassionate One, and vouchsafe them forgiveness!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Comfort our souls afflicted by sins, O all-pure Theotokos, and deliver from transgressions those who hymn thee, O Bride of God!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Leaving not the bosom of the Father:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: All-sustaining, thrice-radiant Unity, divine Principle and Savior of all: preserve and save Thy cantors now from sorrow, passions, and every constraint!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Through symbolic utterances knowing of Thy incomprehensible, thrice-radiant Godhead, we sing unto Thee, O Lord and Lover of mankind, and we glorify Thy power.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: On earth as in heaven, together with the bodiless choirs, indivisibly we distinguish Thee, and in love we glorify Thee: O Unity Trinity, as reigning piously over all that exists!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Not departing from the Father's glory, the super-essential One willingly came down into our lowliness, became incarnate, and raised us unto divine glory, as He is merciful.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Night is without light unto the unbelieving, O...*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: O primordial Nature of Light, Trinity in images, Unity in lights, glory, and power: establish us in Thy love! *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Mind, Word, and Spirit, glorifying the one divine Principle and tri-personal Nature, we pray to be delivered from temptations and all affliction.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Taking shape in human nature from the holy Virgin, O Word of God, Thou didst teach us to sing...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...unto the Trinity in unity, connatural and sharing one throne. [^158]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Sailing in the surge of the billows of...*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: The dominion of equal glory, the monarchical divine Principle, being tri-hypostatic and immutable, one with another we glorify, having distinction only by the existential properties belonging to each. *(Twice)*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: The noetic ranks of angelic splendors praise the tri-personal divine Principle; and with them we too, with earthen lips, sing unto Thee, the Creator of all, as one, and faithfully glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Having by an ineffable word begotten the Word from the Sun, the Father: another eternal Sun has shone forth from the Virgin in the last times, proclaiming the one tri-personal, unfathomable God.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: O consubstantial Trinity, tri-hypostatic Unity...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...have mercy on those whom Thou hast created, O Intangible One, burning away the wickedness of our souls and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn Thy compassion: O God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Brighter than fire and more active than flame, O Mother of goodness, our Sovereign Lady: burning away the sins of men and enlightening the hearts of those who hymn thy great deeds, O woman full of divine grace!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace...*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Ever shining with beam-radiant splendors, O Thrice-Radiant God, inaccessible and super-essential Unity: save those who piously believe in Thee, O Master, and who worship Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Obedient to the voice of the divine prophets, Thee alone, the God of all, we glorify in three Persons, thus crying: Blessed...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers! [^159]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: With earthen lips, using the songs of the immaterial ranks, we sing unto Thee, O Holy Trinity, crying in unity of essence: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: That He Who fashioned man might renew him again, O all-pure one, having become visibly incarnate from thee, He deified mankind who thus cry out: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Vouchsafe the hearts of Thy cantors to be illumined with light-bestowing rays of the thrice-radiant Sun, and grant now unto all, as far as it is possible, ever to behold Thy beauty, O Unity Trinity, who with fitting faith warmly and gloriously hymn Thy majesty.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou upholdest all things, O Triune and Single...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...Lordship without beginning, and rulest over heaven and earth; therefore, drawn by Thy love, ever preserve me who sing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto ages of ages!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Make me a temple of Thy thrice-radiant ray, O Benefactor, Lover of mankind; and by communion and Thy overshadowing, show me inaccessible to invisible foes and bodily passions, O Sovereign Master, my monarchical God, O Lord of glory, that I may warmly sing unto ages of ages!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: The primordial Light, having shone forth from thy womb, O all-pure Mother of God, illumined the whole world with tri-radiant light, and revealed the earth as another heaven, singing: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto ages of ages!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Mother of God and Virgin:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: To exalt and hymn Thee worthily, Whom...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...the Seraphim unceasingly hymn in the highest, we earthen ones are unable to do; nevertheless, taking courage, we sing unto Thee as the Master of all, and we magnify the God Who loves mankind. [^160]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Deliver Thy faithful cantors from bodily ailments and spiritual passions, O unified, indivisible Trinity, and vouchsafe that we be preserved unharmed from every worldly assault!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: O co-equal, primordial, thrice-radiant, almighty Dominion, immutable Beauty, essential Goodness: grant remission of transgressions unto Thy servants, and deliverance from afflictions and passions.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Taking a mind and a soul and the commingling of flesh from thy all-pure womb, O Mother of God, God the Word truly appeared as man, and...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...clearly revealed man as a partaker of the divine nature.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *At "God is the Lord", Resurrection Troparion, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou didst destroy death by Thy Cross, and didst open Paradise unto the thief; Thou didst transform the weeping of the myrrhbearers, and didst command the apostles to proclaim that Christ God is risen, granting great mercy unto the world.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: As the treasure of our Resurrection, O all-hymned one, lead up from the pit and depth of transgressions those who place their hope in thee; for thou hast saved those guilty of sin, having given birth unto our Salvation: who wast a Virgin before childbearing, and in childbearing a Virgin, and after childbearing still a Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *After the 1st Kathisma, Sunday Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: While the tomb was sealed, O Life, Thou didst shine forth from the tomb, O Christ God; and while the doors were shut...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...unto the disciples Thou didst appear, O Resurrection of all, renewing an upright spirit in them according to Thy great mercy. [^161]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Since thou possessest compassion for our weakness, and seest those on earth: have mercy upon the suffering people, O blessed Theotokos! Ever continue praying that we perish not grievously; pray to God as the Compassionate One that our souls may be saved, O all-pure Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sunday Sessional Hymn, Tone 7:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Life lay in the tomb, and a seal lay upon the stone; soldiers guarded the King as one asleep, and angels glorified Him as immortal God; and the women cried: The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Him Who was crucified for our sake, Christ Who cast down the power of death, unceasingly entreat...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...entreat, O Theotokos Virgin, that He may save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst assume our likeness and endure crucifixion in the flesh: save us by Thy Resurrection, O Christ God, as the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *The Songs of Ascents, Tone 7. Antiphon 1:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Turn back the captivity of Zion from delusion, and give me life, O Savior, lifting me up from slavish passions.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: They that sow in sorrows in the south sing with tears: so shall they reap joyous sheaves of ever-living sustenance.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: In the Holy Spirit is the fountain of divine treasures; from Him come wisdom, understanding, and fear: unto Him be praise and glory, honor and dominion!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Unless the Lord build the spiritual house, in vain do we labor; for without Him neither deed nor word is accomplished.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Moved by the Spirit, Thy saints sprout forth as fruit of the womb, fulfilling the Father's commandments of adoption. [^162]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: In the Holy Spirit all things have existence: for He is God before all, Lordship over all, unapproachable Light, and the Life of all.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: They that fear the Lord have found the ways of life: now and ever are they beatified with incorruptible glory.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Seeing thy offspring around thy table like young shoots, rejoice and be glad, bringing them unto Christ, O Chief of Shepherds!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: In the Holy Spirit is the depth of gifts, the riches of glory, and the great depth of judgments: equal in glory with the Father and the Son, and worshipped together as God.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Then the Prokeimenon, Tone 7: Arise, O Lord my God! Verse: I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart. "Let every breath praise the Lord." Verse: Praise God in His saints. The Gospel.*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Sunday Resurrection Canon, Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: By Thy beck, the watery element previously pouring forth was transformed into dry land, O Lord; therefore Israel, walking dryshod, sings unto Thee a song of victory.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: The tyranny of death was condemned by the Tree, through the unrighteous death adjudged unto Thee, O Lord; therefore the prince of darkness, having not prevailed against Thee, was justly cast out.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Hades drew near unto Thee, but unable to crush Thy body with its teeth, its jaws were shattered; and Thou, O Savior, having destroyed the pangs of death, didst rise on the third day.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: The pangs of foremother Eve were loosed: escaping childbearing pangs, thou didst give birth without wedlock; therefore, knowing thee clearly as the all-pure Theotokos, all we glorify thee.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Second Canon, Cross-Resurrection. Ode 1. Heirmos: Like the former:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Christ poured forth two life-bearing streams for me upon the Cross from His pierced side: let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified! [^163]

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Dwelling in the tomb and rising on the third day, Christ granted incorruption unto the dead who awaited Him: let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou wast revealed as alone a virgin even after childbearing; for thou didst give birth to the Creator of the world: let us sing unto Him, for He is glorified!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: *Another Canon, to the Most Holy Theotokos, Tone 7. Ode 1. Heirmos: By Thy beck, into an earthen:*

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Having given birth to the abyss of compassion, O Virgin, illumine my soul with thy light-bearing radiance, that I may worthily hymn the abyss of thy wonders!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Seeing the sinful arrows wounding us, O Word, as the Benefactor Thou didst have mercy; therefore, ineffably united...

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: ...to flesh from thee, O all-pure one, is the super-divine One.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Corruptible and frail human nature was held fast by death; but thou, O Sovereign Lady, having conceived the Life, didst lead it up from incorruption unto life.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: In the beginning, O Lord and Savior, by Thine almighty Word Thou didst establish the heavens, and all their host by the all-creating divine Spirit: establish me upon the immovable rock of Thy confession!

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Having mounted upon the Tree of Thine own will, O merciful Savior, Thou didst suffer for our sake, and didst endure the wound that mediated humility and salvation unto the faithful, through which we were reconciled unto Thy merciful Father.

items.slavonic_text: Мт҃и ᲂу҆́бѡ позна́сѧ па́че є҆стества̀ бц҃е: пре[бы́сть]
items.english_text: Thou cleansest me from the wound, O Christ, who was wounded in soul by the serpent's bite, and Thou hast shown forth light unto those who of old...

items.slavonic_text: слежа́щꙋ ми во тлѣ́нїи: соше́дъ бо во а҆́дъ, крⷭ҇томъ совоздви́же мѧ̀. *Бг҃о.*
items.english_text: when I lay in corruption of old: for having descended into Hades, by the Cross Thou didst raise me up together with Thyself. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Неискꙋсомꙋ́жныѧ тѝ мт҃ре мольба́ми, мі́рꙋ смире́нїе пода́ждь сп҃се: и҆ цр҃ю побѣ́дꙋ да́рꙋй насопроти́вныѧ врагѝ, и҆ неизрече́ннѣй тѝ сла́вѣ славосло́вѧщихъ тѧ̀ сподо́би. *И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ. Свы́шше си́лꙋ.*
items.english_text: By the supplications of Thy Mother who knew not man, grant peace to the world, O Savior, and grant victory to the king against adversary enemies, and make worthy of Thine ineffable glory those who glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Пла́менное ѡ҆рꙋ́жїе ᲂу҆гаси́лъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и, є҆гда̀ тѧ̀ лю́дїе беззако́ннїи пригвозди́ша на крⷭ҇тнѣмъ: разбо́йникꙋ же ра́йскїѧ ѿве́рзе две́ри. сп҃слъ є҆сѝ чл҃колю́бче, и҆́же вѣ́рою непреста́нно тебѐ сла́вѧщихъ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: The power from on high.*

items.slavonic_text: Воскре́съ ѿ гро́ба своего̀, жена́мъ хрⷭ҇ѐ пе́рвѣе себѐ ꙗ҆влѧ́еши: и҆ разрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ є҆́ѵвѣ печа́ль, а҆да́маже во тлѝ впа́дшасѧ совоздви́глъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоᲂу҆тро́бный бг҃ъ. тѣ́мже всѝ пое́мъ твоѐ воста́нїе. *Бг҃о.*
items.english_text: Thou didst quench the flaming sword, O Lord, when the lawless people nailed Thee to the Cross; and to the thief Thou didst open the gates of Paradise. Thou hast saved, O Lover of mankind, those who unceasingly glorify Thee in faith.

items.slavonic_text: Е҆го́же прїе́мши гдⷭ҇а водѣ́вственномъ чре́вѣ, воплоще́на прⷭ҇чтаѧ породѝ. бг҃опремѣни́телна мольба́ми тѝ мт҃рними, на́мъ рабо́мъ свои̑мъ да́дъ: приста́нище спасє́мы.
items.english_text: Having risen from Thy tomb, O Christ, Thou didst first manifest Thyself to the women, and Thou didst dispel the grief of Eve, and didst raise up together with Thyself Adam who had fallen into corruption, as the compassionate God; therefore we all sing of Thy rising. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: *И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ. Внача́тцѣ нб҃са всеси́лнымъ сло́вомъ.*
items.english_text: Having received the Lord into thy virginal womb, O all-pure one, thou didst give birth to Him incarnate. Grant Him to be reconciled to us, His servants, through thy maternal supplications, as a haven wherein we are saved.[^164]

items.slavonic_text: Змі́й поползе́нъ и҆з̾ є҆де́ма, менѐ бж҃тва желꙗ́нїемъ прелести́въ, ве́рже на зе́мли. но̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ мл҃ти́въ неєстество́мъ бл҃гоᲂу҆тро́бне, ᲂу҆ще́дривъ ѡ҆божа́етъ, во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й всели́сѧ, и҆ подо́бенъ мнѣ̀ бы́въ мт҃и дв҃о.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: In the beginning, the heavens with Thine all-powerful Word.*

items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослове́нъ пло́дъ чре́ва твое́го дв҃о бц҃е, всѣ́хъ ра́дости: ра́дость бо всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ роди́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ весе́лїе вои́стиннꙋ, разорѧ́ющи печа́ль грѣхо́внꙋю бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ.
items.english_text: The crawling serpent, having crept out from Eden and deceived me with the craving for divinity, cast me down to the earth; but as the merciful One, by nature compassionate, showing bountiful mercy, He deifies me, having made His abode in thy womb and become like unto me, O Mother and Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Blessed is the fruit of thy womb, O Virgin Theotokos, the Joy of all; for thou didst bear joy unto all the world, and true gladness, destroying sinful sorrow, O Bride of God.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Eternal life, and light, and peace, O Virgin Birth-giver of God, hast thou brought forth unto us, quieting mankind's ancient enmity toward the Father and God,

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: who pacified it through faith and graceful confession.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Without leaving the Father's bosom, having descended to earth, O Christ God, I heard the mystery of Thine economy, and I glorified Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Having given His shoulders over to scourging, He Who was incarnate of the Virgin; when the servant had sinned, the innocent Master is beaten, absolving my transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Standing before the judge, the Judge of judges receives judgment like a condemned man from lawless judges, and is buffeted by an earthen hand: He Who created man as God, and Who judges the earth righteously. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: As the true Mother of God, pray to thy Creator and Son to guide me unto the saving haven of thy glorious will, O all-immaculate one.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Knowing no sin, yet made sin for its sake, O Lord, that He might know it, accepting to be formed in what was foreign, that Thou mightest make manifest their madness; and Thou didst slay the tyrant of deceit.[^165]

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Having risen from the dead and raised up together with Thyself Adam, who had fallen by his own will; for whose sake I heard of Thy power, O Lord, and that Thou didst come to save all Thy good servants. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Having come from the snowy part of the mountain, O Virgin Maiden, He was enrolled among servants, delivering all from servitude, He Who rules as Master unto ages; therefore we glorify thee who didst bear Him.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Without leaving the Father's bosom.*

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Having appeared all-chosen and good unto God before creation, illumine with thy radiance those who sing of thee.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Thou didst bear God for earthly mortals, O pure one, incarnate

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: from thy pure blood, delivering from grievous sins those who honor and glorify thee with love, O all-pure one.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Rational nature ministers unto Him Who came forth from thee beyond understanding, O praised one, having now partaken of the ineffable mystery of thy childbearing, O all-blessed one.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Night is unillumined to the faithless, but unto the faithful there is illumination in the sweetness of Thy words; and for this cause I rise early unto Thee, and I praise Thy Divinity.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: For the sake of Thy servants Thou wast sold, O Christ, and Thou didst endure buffeting, procuring freedom for those who sing: I rise early unto Thee, and I praise Thy Divinity.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: By Thy divine power, O Christ, through the weakness of the flesh,

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Thou didst cast down the strong one, and by Thy Resurrection, O Savior, Thou hast shown me to be victorious over death. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Thou didst give birth to God, O pure Mother, incarnate from thee, O lauded in godlike manner; for thou knewest not the male sex, but didst bring forth from the Holy Spirit.[^166]

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: When He was numbered with the lawless and lifted up upon the Place of the Skull, the luminaries hid themselves, and the earth was shaken, and the temple's splendor was rent in twain, making manifest the falling away of the Hebrews.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Thee, Who didst destroy the tyrant's power by the might of Thine incomprehensible Godhead, and didst raise the dead by Thy Resurrection, we glorify with hymns. *Theotokion:*

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: O Mother of the King and God, all-hymned Theotokos, unto those who in faith

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: and love ever praise thee with hymns, send down cleansing from sins through thy supplications.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Night is unillumined to the faithless.*

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Jacob beheld a ladder established on high, and is taught the figure of thy virginity that knew not wedlock; for through thee God conversed with men, O all-pure Sovereign Lady.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Having now found eternal redemption through thee, O Virgin, we earnestly cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Sovereign Lady! And rejoicing in thy light, O all-pure one, we magnify thee with hymns.

items.slavonic_text: Жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ смире́нїе, бг҃ороди́телнице дв҃о роди́ла є҆сѝ на́мъ: вѣ́тхꙋю чл҃кѡмъ бра́нь, ко ѿц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ бг҃ꙋ ᲂу҆кроти́вша
items.english_text: Having found thee alone as a lily in the midst of thorns, O Virgin, shining with the brilliance of purity and with the light of maidenhood, the Bridegroom brought thee to Himself as a bride, O all-hymned one.
