items.slavonic_text: Телесе́мъ тлѣ́ннымъ, нетлѣ́нїе бж҃твено стяжа́вше, страстьмѝ сп҃ти чтны́и, безсме́ртномꙋ крѣ́пко подо́бящеся всехва́ль
items.english_text: With divine myrrh did divine spiritual grace anoint thee, [first-enthroned bishop] of the people of Myra...

items.slavonic_text: первопресто́лна, и҆ пома́завши добродѣ́телми сщ҃еннѣ́йшими мі́ру конца̀, бл҃гооу҆ха́нными же мл҃твами ѕлосмра́дныѧ прогонѧ́ща стра́сти всегда̀, сегѡ̀ ра́ди тѧ̀ вѣ́рно сла́вимъ, и҆ бл҃гть твою̀ чте́мъ сщ҃е Никола́е.
items.english_text: ...first-enthroned bishop, and having anointed the ends of the world with most sacred virtues, and ever driving away foul-smelling passions by thy fragrant prayers; therefore do we faithfully glorify thee, and honor thy grace, O holy hierarch Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣщꙋ́ тѧ неѡу҆гаси́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́лника всемї́рна, натве́рди возсїѧ́вша цр҃ко́внѣй сла́вне, мі́ръ просвѣща́юща, и҆ бѣ́дъ лю́тыхъ мглу̀ ѿгонѧ́ща, и҆ и҆зима́юща печа́лей зи́му, и҆ тишинꙋ̀ содѣлова́ющꙋ глубо́кꙋ, подо́лгу оу҆блажа́емъ, Никола́е.
items.english_text: As an unquenchable candle, as a universal luminary shining forth upon the firmament of the Church, O glorious one, enlightening the world, driving away the mist of cruel misfortunes, taking away the winter of sorrows, and producing a deep calm, do we worthily call thee blessed, O Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Пресла́вное житїѐ твоѐ, всюдꙋ прекра́сна тѧ̀ показа̀ бг҃омꙋ́дре сщ҃еннѣ́йшїй. сщ҃телемъ бл҃голѣ́пїе. прпдбнымъ оу҆краше́нїе. ꙗ҆́кѡ слн҃це на землѝ лꙋча̀ распросте́ръ, и҆ ѡ҆зари́лъ,
items.english_text: Thy most glorious life hath revealed thee everywhere as beautiful, O divinely wise, most sacred father, the comeliness of hierarchs and the adornment of the venerable; spreading thy rays like the sun upon the earth, thou hast irradiated...

items.slavonic_text: ри́лъ, всѧ вѣ́рныхъ срдца̀, соверша́ющимъ свѣтоно́снꙋю ти, и҆ бж҃тве́ннꙋю па́мѧть всебл҃же́нне Никола́е. Сла́ва и҆ Нн҃ѣ, Бг҃о.
items.english_text: ...the hearts of all the faithful as they celebrate thy radiant and divine memory, O all-blessed Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: И҆скꙋше́нїа всѧ́ка и҆ ловле́нїа ѕмїа лести́ваго, и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ, и҆ стра́стемъ стремле́нїа ѡ҆бꙋзда́й молѧ́сѧ, и҆ оу҆ма̀ моегѡ̀ мглу̀ и҆ ѡ҆мраче́нїе ѿженѝ, и҆ ѡ҆кормѝ кприста́нищꙋ бж҃твенныхъ заповѣ́дей сн҃а твоегѡ̀ бг҃ома́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ да̀ непреста́ннѡ почита́ю тѧ̀.
items.english_text: From every temptation and snare of the deceitful serpent deliver me, O all-immaculate Lady; bridle the violent assaults of passions, I pray Thee; dispel the mist and darkening of my mind, and pilot me unto the haven of the divine commandments of Thy Son, O Mother of God, that unceasingly I may honor Thee.

items.slavonic_text: А҆пт҃лскїй ли́къ, дх҃омъ ст҃ы́мъ просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ Хе: и҆ на́шꙋ скве́рнꙋ грѣхо́внꙋю, тѣ́хъ ра́ди ѡ҆мы́й бж҃е и҆ поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 4:* [^244]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: The choir of the apostles hast Thou enlightened by the Holy Spirit, O Christ; for their sake wash away our defilement of sin, O God, and have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thy Holy Spirit revealed unlettered disciples as teachers, O Christ God; and by their eloquent, divinely inspired tongues He abolished delusion, as Thou art almighty.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Living victims, rational whole-burnt offerings, martyrs of the Lord, perfect sacrifices of God, lambs knowing God and known of God, whose sheepfold is inaccessible to wolves: pray that we also may be pastured with you beside the water of rest.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Having Thee, O Mother of God, as hope and helper, we fear not the assaults of the enemy; for Thou savest our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Then, "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart." Troparion to the Apostles:* **"O holy apostles,"** *and to Nicholas, Tone 4:* **"A rule of faith."** *Glory; Both now: Theotokion:* **"The Word of the Father, Christ our God."** *Dismissal.*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:* [^245]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thou hast revealed Thy disciples, O Christ, as luminaries to the ends of the earth, shining Thy knowledge upon souls in darkness, O Sovereign Master; and having eclipsed the deceit of idols on their account, Thou hast enlightened the world with the teachings of piety: by their supplications save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Even as Moses led Israel out of bondage...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...through the Red Sea, and drowned Pharaoh with Thy right hand, so did Thy disciples, wise in wonders, cleave the sea of cruel godlessness, and guide the people unto Thee, O Word without beginning and only Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Refuge of those in perils, reconciliation unto God for sinners, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady: save us from every tribulation, and from human malice, and from dread torment, and from the dishonor of passions, who with unhesitating faith ever invoke Thee, O all-hymned Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Preachers of the faith didst Thou reveal Thy disciples to be unto the world, O Savior, guiding the nations through them unto Thy knowledge; for with the beams of the Word they enlightened all, the darkness of ignorance...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...having dispelled through faith: by their prayers save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Manfully in the flesh did ye endure torments and wounds, O passion-bearers; for drawn by longing toward the ageless life, ye worthily received the incorruptible crown of the kingdom of Christ; therefore pray ye that our souls may find mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thee do we magnify, crying aloud, O Mother of God: Thou art the only blessed one, and from Thee ineffably was Christ our God born.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4:*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: As rays did Christ the Sun of righteousness send you forth, O glorious apostles, to enlighten all the earth; by your divine prayers ye illumine all with unwaning divine light, enlightening those who faithfully celebrate your holy memory.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Unashamed hope of those who trust in Thee, who alone beyond nature didst bear in the flesh Christ our God: pray Him with the holy apostles to grant cleansing of transgressions unto the inhabited world, and unto us all amendment of life before the end.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Then, Canon to the Holy Apostles. Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos: The Red Sea...* [^246]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: As divine instruments of the Comforter, sounding forth His voice ever by divine inspirations, the glorious apostles of Christ have chanted unto us a truly saving song.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Lying upon the bed of sloth, and my soul cruelly languishing in deadly sinful disease: vouchsafe me your visitation, O glorious eyewitnesses of Christ.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Ye who by the Word released the tongues of the nations from irrationality, O apostles: from irrational deeds cruelly...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...darkened, deliver my heart; comfort me and illuminate me by grace, O glorious ones.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst remain incorruptibly a Virgin after childbirth, having borne beyond word Him Who for our sake was revealed like unto us: Him do Thou fervently pray to enlighten our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another Canon to Saint Nicholas. Ode 1. Heirmos: The captains of old...* [^247]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Having inherited the sorrowless life, O father, and being ever filled with spiritual joy: dispel, I pray thee, every sorrow from my soul, that rejoicing I may glorify thee, O most sacred father Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thou wast set spiritually upon the lampstand of virtues, and as light dost thou enlighten the hearts of the faithful, O holy hierarch Nicholas; therefore, praying unto thee in faith, dispel the darkness from my soul by thy radiant prayers.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Ever sailing over the deep of corruptible life amid the assaults of all manner of trials, may I find thee, O venerable one, as a helmsman transforming the storm into calm by thy divine prayers.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Possessing unsleeping prayer, O Pure One, lull to sleep our soul-destroying passions by thy sacred intercessions, granting divine and saving vigilance unto the fulfilling of God's will.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: Thy Church rejoiceth in Thee...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: The streams of Thy spiritual rivers, O Master, the disciples, have holily gladdened Thy city, O God.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Heavenly citizens, fellow servants with the spiritual ranks, O all-glorious apostles: deliver us from every affliction.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: O Christ Who hast established Thy spiritual heavens, establish me by their prayers upon the rock...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...of Thy desires, as Thou art compassionate.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: As a Mother does she pray Thee, O Sovereign Master, together with the choirs of the disciples—even she who purely gave birth to Thee: grant us Thy mercies.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon to Saint Nicholas], Ode 3. Heirmos: Not in wisdom...* [^248]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: A weapon didst thou appear, slaying the warring enemies; keep us uninjured from their temptations, O Nicholas, fulfilling the divine will.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Heal the crushing of my soul, O holy hierarch, who hast crushed the snares and traps of the enemy, that in faith I may magnify thee as my protector.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thou who didst cast down the soulless idols of Artemis: destroy the passionate idols of my mind by thy divine intercessions, O father Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thee having acquired as protectress, O all-immaculate Virgin...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...turn our sorrow into joy, and deliver us from sorrows and those things that bring forth death.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst bring Thine elect steeds upon the sea, O Lover of mankind, troubling the waters of heresy, and proclaiming unto all Thy true knowledge.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Stars that enlightened the spiritual firmament of the Church with piety, O glorious apostles: deliver me from the night of ignorance and transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Revealed as sharpened arrows of the Mighty One, O apostles: extinguish now the fiery arrows of my heart, and establish my mind.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: My soul, embittered by venom through the bite of the adversary, heal with efficacious medicine...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...O Christ, by the prayers of Her who bore Thee, and of Thy sacred apostles.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon to Saint Nicholas], Ode 4. Heirmos: He Who sitteth in glory...* [^249]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thy most glorious life hath revealed thee everywhere as most glorious, glorified by divine wonders, an adornment of chief hierarchs and a boast unto all who honor thee with joyful songs, O Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Upon the high throne, O blessed one, hast thou glorified God, radiant with the splendors of divine humility; make us to be partakers thereof by thy well-pleasing supplications, O wise father.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Those unjustly led away to death didst thou deliver, O father, kindled with sacred zeal; therefore do we cry aloud unto thee: likewise snatch us by thy prayers from the afflictions that slay us cruelly...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...by thy prayers.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Dwelling in the heavens, O Nicholas, amidst invisible joys, thou comest unto all that call upon thee, lightening the diseases of our souls and granting divine comfort.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: The angelic hosts, struck with awe, O all-immaculate Lady, hymn the majesty of Thy divine childbirth; with them, O Virgin Lady, pray that all may be saved who honor and bless Thee in faith.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Thou, O Lord, art my light...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: As branches of the living Vine, blossoming with clusters, the glorious apostles have watered all with the wine of spiritual joy.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Unto the light of God's commandments guide me, O apostles, who foolishly abide in the darkness of spiritual despondency.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Deliver us from spiritual transgressions, and from the judgment to come, and from passions and perils, O blessed apostles.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Save me, O God, as Lover of mankind, save me by the supplications of Her who ineffably bore Thee, and of all Thy divine apostles.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon to Saint Nicholas], Ode 5. Heirmos: The ungodly shall not see...* [^250]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thou didst set like the sun in the West, O wise father, and hast dawned in the East with the radiant splendors of thy miracles, enlightening the whole earth beneath the sun, O father Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: O holy Nicholas, hear us in days when perils and sorrows assail, driving away every affliction by the grace of the Spirit dwelling within thee.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Having my soul crushed by worldly passions, I call upon thee for help...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...O holy Nicholas: make haste and grant me complete healing, having besought the Sinless One.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee with spiritual eyes, O undefiled and pure Virgin, Isaiah cried aloud: "Behold, from a Virgin Child of God the Lord shall be born for the regeneration of mankind!"

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: I came into the deep of the sea...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: The divinely chosen sheep of the Good Shepherd, scattered throughout the world, by faith transformed the wolf-like savagery of the nations into sheep-like gentleness.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Fair-fruited trees of the divine Paradise: transform the utter barrenness of my wretched soul into the fruitful habit of virtue, O apostles.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Wounded was I by the weapon of pleasure, and I am dead...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...yet having received grace from Christ to raise the dead, O glorious ones: revive my slain, wretched soul.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Calm the raging tempest of my soul, O God of all, Who art compassionate, by the prayers of the Mother of God who bore Thee, and of Thine apostles and martyrs.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon to Saint Nicholas], Ode 6. Heirmos: I came into the depths of the sea...* [^251]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Strengthened by the might of the Savior, O divinely wise father, thou wast able to destroy the invisible foe; from his cruel harm deliver us by thy supplications, O father Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: From torment in Gehenna and from the most harmful vexation of deceitful men deliver us by thy sacred prayers, O most glorious Nicholas.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: As of old the commanders doomed unjustly to die were delivered by thy prayers, so snatch us also from every harm, O worthy of all beatitude.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Thy people and Thy city pray Thee, O Mother of God: deliver us from every calamity, O all-pure Sovereign Lady, and from eternal condemnation there.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the fiery furnace the Persian children of...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: By the swiftness of the most holy preaching, O guileless apostles of Christ, ye destroyed the winter of delusion, and with the knowledge of God do ye warm the minds of the faithful.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Ever gushing forth fragrant myrrh, O divine apostles, ye fill with the fragrance of spiritual myrrh those who flee unto you, and drive away foul-smelling passions.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Corrupted as I am by carnal indecencies, O glorious disciples of the incorruptible Word, save me as I chant: Blessed art Thou, O God of the Church of Thy glory, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Choirs of angels, choirs of martyrs and apostles, ever pray Thee, O Word: in the multitude of Thy tender compassions have mercy on all, for the sake of the Mother of God, as Thou art merciful.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon to Saint Nicholas], Ode 7. Heirmos: The youths...* [^252]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: O holy Nicholas, pray the one holy God Who resteth in the saints to sanctify us, and to send down upon us His rich mercies.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Righteous, upright, and meek, gentle and guileless, O glorious one: thou wast elevated to the height of the priesthood, O most glorious one, performing wonders and signs.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Having observed the divine laws, lo, thou didst appear as a most honorable temple of God; therefore do we cry aloud unto thee, O all-blessed father: deliver us from all iniquity by thine intercession.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Lull to sleep the rebellions of passions in my soul by thy vigilant prayer, granting me vigilance, O Maiden, driving far away the slumber of despondency.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Stretching out his hands, Daniel...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Fire-breathing mouths of Christ, who closed the mouths of godlessness, and scattered saving preaching everywhere: deliver from the mouth of the spiritual wolf those who cry: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Sound the trumpet round about my slain soul, O glorious apostles of Christ, divinely resounding trumpets, and raise it up from the grave of despair and cruel despondency, that it may chant: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Me who have trampled Thy laws, O Christ, through corruption of mind, me the prodigal who have slipped into passions and ever enslaved myself to evil custom: despise me not, O Sovereign Master, by the supplications of Thy sacred disciples.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: O Mary, Lady of all: me who am held in bondage by the serpent...

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: ...and who sin continually, liberate me by thy prayers, and make me a servant to live purely unto Christ, that I may chant: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Another [Canon to Saint Nicholas], Ode 8. Heirmos: O Redeemer of all...* [^253]

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: With divine eloquence, O Nicholas, didst thou manifestly stop the open mouths of the lawless, and didst deliver many from the ruinous heresy of Arius, who chant in orthodox fashion: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Named after victory, O holy hierarch, show us through thy prayers to be victors over passions that bring forth death, and over the deceitful tongue of lawless men, who ever bless thee in faith.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Be thou entreated, O wonder-worker Nicholas, to send down unto us thy saving help in the day of judgment, when asking in faith we pray unto thee.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: In orthodox manner, O faithful, let us worship the uncreated Holy Trinity, crying unto the Father without beginning, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Vouchsafe me Thy mercy, O blessed Sovereign Lady, who didst give birth to the good and merciful God; and standing before me in the hour of judgment, deliver me from condemnation there.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A stone cut out without hand from a mountain...*

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Having received authority from Christ to bind and to loose: loose the bond of my transgressions, and bind me unto the love of God, and make me a partaker of the kingdom, O divine apostles.

items.slavonic_text: Некни́жныѧ оу҆чнки, дх҃ъ тво́й ст҃ый каз́телѧ ꙗ҆вѝ Хе бг҃е: многовѣща́ны бг҃огла́сне ꙗ҆зы́къ, пре́лест ѡ҆упразднѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ.
items.english_text: Divine clouds of the Sovereign Master, water now with divine showers my heart dried up by all manner of evil deeds, and show it to be fruitful, O glorious apostles.

items.slavonic_text: Ка́менїе и҆збра́нное на положе́наго во гла́вꙋ ᲂу҆́гла ка́мене: созида́ете всѣ́хъ вѣ́рныхъ срⷣца, ка́менемъ вѣ́ры вра́жїѧ созида́нїѧ а҆пⷭли разверга́юще. * Бг҃о.
items.english_text: As chosen stones upon the Stone laid at the head of the corner (1 Peter 2:6, Psalm 117:22 LXX), ye build up the hearts of all the faithful, O apostles, casting down the enemy's structures by the stone of faith.

items.slavonic_text: Со ст҃ы́ми а҆́гг҃лы бж҃тве́нными а҆пⷭлы, со сла́вными мч҃нки: своего̀ молѝ сн҃а и҆ гдⷭа бг҃ороди́тельнице прчⷭтаѧ, ѿ бѣ́дъ и҆зба́вити рабы̑ своѧ̑. * И҆́нъ І҆рмо́съ: Е҆́ва ᲂу҆́бѡ.
items.english_text: With the holy angels and the divine apostles, with the glorious martyrs, pray Thy Son and Lord, O all-immaculate Mother of God, to deliver Thy servants from perils.

items.slavonic_text: И҆сцѣле́нїѧ соверша́ѧ гро́бъ тво́й, и҆сточа́етъ мѵ́ро бл҃гоꙋха́нїѧ прпⷣбне, и҆̀же вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю пристꙋпа́ющимъ нїко́лае, и҆ твою̀ па́мѧть чтꙋ́щимъ: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos: Eve indeed...* [^254]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ сл҃нце бг҃облж҃е́нне нїко́лае, всю̀ подсл҃нечнꙋю ѡ҆зарѧ́еши бж҃твенныхъ чꙋде́съ лꙋча́ми, тмꙋ̀ лю́тыхъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй ѿго́нѧѧ ст҃е́нными хода́та́йствы твои́ми
items.english_text: Wrought with healings, thy tomb pours forth fragrant myrrh, O venerable one, unto those who approach with faith and love, O Nicholas, and who honor thy memory; therefore do we all magnify thee.

items.slavonic_text: О҆би́льнѡ ᲂу҆ще́дри на́съ нїко́лае, жите́йскими напа́стьми и҆ бѣсо́вскими ле́стьми: лꙋка́выхъ же чл҃къ и҆скꙋше́ньми, лю́тѣ ѡ҆бурева́емыхъ всегда̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ да тѧ̀ любо́вїю ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_text: As a sun, O divinely blessed Nicholas, thou enlightenest all under the sun with the rays of divine miracles, driving away the mist of cruel misfortunes by thy holy intercessions...

items.slavonic_text: Дне́ и҆ часа̀ стра́шнаго помина́й ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, є҆гда̀ тѧ̀ хо́щетъ привестѝ на сꙋ́дъ влⷣка, и҆ сꙋди́ти твои̑мъ дѣѧ́нїемъ та́йнымъ, возопи́й є҆мꙋ̀, сп҃се спаси́ мѧ ни́колы молба́ми. * Бг҃о.
items.english_text: ...O adornment of chief hierarchs.

items.slavonic_text: Гла́съ тебѣ̀ бж҃тве́ннаго гаврїи́ла прино́симъ ра́достнѡ, и҆ возвыва́емъ: ра́дꙋйсѧ ра́ю, и҆́же дре́во живо́тное посредѣ̀ и҆мꙋ́щаѧ всегда̀. пресла́внаѧ пола́то сло́вꙋ, ра́дꙋйсѧ дв҃о всенепоро́чнаѧ. * Свѣⷮ а҆пⷭлѡмъ.
items.english_text: Abundantly show mercy unto us, O Nicholas, who are ever cruelly storm-tossed by worldly assaults, and demonic deceptions, and temptations of evil men, that with love we may call thee blessed.

items.slavonic_text: Петра̀ и҆ па́ѵла, а҆ндре́а, и҆ ꙗ҆́кова. варѳоломе́а
items.english_text: Keep in mind the dread day and hour, O my soul, when the Master will bring thee unto judgment and judge thy secret deeds; cry aloud unto Him: O Savior, save me by the supplications of Nicholas!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Joyfully do we offer Thee the greeting of divine Gabriel, and cry aloud: Rejoice, O paradise, who ever hast within the Tree of Life! Rejoice, O most glorious palace of the Word, O all-immaculate Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Peter and Paul, Andrew, and James, Bartholomew...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...and Matthew, James and Philip, Thomas and Simon, Luke and John, and Mark: let us praise the apostles of the Lord.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: O unwedded Virgin, unceasingly pray Christ, together with the wise apostles, and with the multitude of martyrs, and with wise Nicholas, that all who have placed their hope in Thee may be delivered from every tribulation, O Maiden.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: The choir of the apostles hast Thou enlightened by the Holy Spirit, O Christ; and for their sake wash away our defilement of sin, and have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Thy Holy Spirit revealed unlettered disciples as teachers, O Christ God; and by their eloquent, divinely inspired tongues He abolished delusion, as Thou art almighty.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Precious is the death of Thy saints, O Lord (Psalm 115:6 LXX); for by sword...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...and fire, and with contrite soul they poured forth their blood, having hope in Thee to receive the reward of their labors; they endured and received from Thee, O Savior, great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Thee have we acquired as a rampart, O all-immaculate Mother of God, and a calm haven and confirmation; therefore pray, and pilot and save me who am storm-tossed in this life.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *On Thursday, the Beatitudes, Tone 4:* [^255]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: On account of the tree was Adam exiled from paradise, but on account of the tree of the Cross the thief was settled in paradise; for the one by tasting transgressed the commandment of Him Who made him, while the other, crucified together with Thee, confessed Thee to be the hidden God, crying aloud: Remember me in Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Being the rational sheep of the Shepherd and Lamb...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...in the midst of wolves were ye sent forth by Him like gentle lambs, by divine preaching transforming their savagery into meekness, crying in faith with unwavering mind: Remember us in Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Having traversed the ends of the earth, O apostles of the Lord, like radiant stars ye dispel the darkness of delusion, and flash forth saving light upon those who were deceived; therefore do we call you blessed, O preachers of Christ, entreating: pray unto the Lord for us.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Crushed by torments and scorched by material fire, ye consumed the bitter material of polytheism, O divinely blessed ones; and now ye pour forth streams of healings unto those who come unto you with fervent faith, O preachers of Christ, and who cry: O Christ, remember us in Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: With unswerving mindset and sober mind let us teach this unto Him Who abideth in the highest, seated together with the consubstantial Spirit: O indivisible Trinity, Who hast composed all things by Thy Word, enlightening all who in faith call upon Thee and ever cry aloud: Remember us in Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: In truth Thou art the joy of the apostles and the unfading crown of the passion-bearers, O all-immaculate Virgin Mother of God; with them entreat for us, O Sovereign Lady, deliverance from transgressions and amendment of life, who in faith hymn Thee and cry aloud: Save those who bow down before Thee, O Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *On Thursday Evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5.*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Let all the trees of the forest rejoice (Psalm 95:12 LXX)...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...beholding the all-honorable Wood gladdened by the Passion of the Master, flashing forth grace like a flame of fire, pouring out all gifts like waters, enlightening souls and thoughts, cleansing diseases, driving away snares, putting to flight invisible demons afar, manifestly conquering foreign nations, ever granting victories unto rulers over barbarians, and unto the faithful salvation and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Bowing down in faith before the place where the feet of the Lord stood (Psalm 131:7 LXX), even as the prophet said: we glorify the crucified Christ Who nailed our sins unto the Cross, Who abolished the curse proceeding from the tree, and reconciled unto the Father those who were estranged from Him in thoughts; kissing His hand and foot nails, the spear and reed, the robe and crown, the bonds...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...and insults, and all other things that He endured, we piously honor them and are saved.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Let us crucify all the members of our flesh, and die unto the world, and having longed to walk in the footsteps of Christ the Master of the world, let us carry His divine Cross upon our shoulders, by rejecting carnal wantonness and evil lusts that draw the soul unto sin, thinking to stand before Him and to behold Him nailed upon the Cross, Who with sighing yielded His soul into the hands of the Father, that we may ever be inseparable from Him.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *Other Stichera to the Most Holy Theotokos.*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: When Thou, like a vine, didst behold the unplanted Cluster Whom Thou didst bud forth hanging upon the Tree, pierced with a spear in His divine ribs, what is this, cried she, O my Son and my God? How...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...is it that Thou, Who healest all diseases and passions, sufferest Passion, being passionless according to Thy divine nature? Why have the ungrateful people rendered these things unto Thee, the Benefactor, in return for benefits? cried the all-immaculate one. But unceasingly pray Him by His Passion to deliver me from passions, that I may glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Let us all weep and stretch out our hands, and strike our breasts weeping warmly, and bowing our knees, striking the earth earnestly with our face, and sending up sighing to the height, who by unfitting deeds have provoked God unto anger through rejection of His commandments, crying aloud: deliver us from all torment at the judgment to come, who have grieved Thee and are now turning back, by the supplications of Thy Mother, for whose sake Thou didst endure the Cross, being incarnate, and...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...make us partakers of Thy kingdom!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Unto whom hast thou become likened, O my soul, ever advancing in worse things, and foolishly adding more sores unto thy wounds, so that plainly the whole body is diseased; not considering that the Judge draws near, before Whom thou shalt stand to receive the punishment and torment due unto thy deeds: but turn back and fall down before the Virgin, crying: O Sovereign Lady, Sovereign Lady, despise me not who have provoked the bountiful God, Who was born of Thee for the salvation of mankind, and was crucified in the flesh!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: For our redemption and as a great ransom didst Thou deign to give Thy most pure blood, O my sinless Christ, desiring that all should obtain salvation; therefore Thy Mother, beholding Thee...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...sobbing and tearing her hair, cried aloud: O Child, all-immaculate Lamb, Who desirest to redeem the world by Thy precious blood: how hast Thou set from mine eyes, O Savior, O unsetting Sun, Who grantest enlightenment, and peace, and great mercy unto all!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 5:* [^259]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: O Lord, when of old under Moses the prophet only the prefiguration of Thy Cross was manifested, it conquered Thine enemies; but now holding the Cross itself, we ask for help: establish Thy Church, and grant victory unto our ruler as unto King Constantine, for the sake of Thy great mercy, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Though Thy Cross is visible as wood in its essence, O Christ, yet is it clothed with divine power; and being sensibly manifested unto the world, it noetically works our salvation...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...bowing down before which, we glorify Thee, O Savior: have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Having had no regard for all earthly things, and manfully braving torments, ye failed not of your blessed hopes, but became heirs of the heavenly kingdom, O all-praised martyrs; possessing boldness before God the Lover of mankind, entreat peace for the world and great mercy for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Beholding of old her Lamb lifted up upon the Cross, the Virgin Mother and all-blessed Maiden cried aloud with tears: Woe is me, O my Son, how diest Thou, Who by nature art immortal God?

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *On Friday at Matins, after the 1st Stichology, Sessional Hymns of the Cross, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: The Place of the Skull became paradise; for no sooner was the wood of the Cross planted, than straightway budded forth the Cluster...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...of life; glory to Thee, O Savior, unto our gladness, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Let us, the faithful, hymn and glorify our Savior and Deliverer, Who was crucified willingly as God, and as He was well pleased; for He nailed the sins of mankind unto the Cross, delivering the human race from deception, and vouchsafed us the kingdom.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Standing of old by the Cross of the Lord, the pure Mother of God sobbed, crying aloud: Woe is me, O my Child! Woe is me, the light of mine eyes! How art Thou stretched out upon the Cross, Who by divine power didst stretch out heaven like a curtain (Psalm 103:2 LXX), and by Thy command bringest forth fountains of waters from the sea!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymns, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Having endured crucifixion by Thy voluntary counsel, Thou hast delivered mankind from corruption, O Savior; we, the faithful, hymn Thee and bow down before Thee, for...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...Thou hast enlightened us by the power of the Cross, and all of us glorify Thee, O bountiful Lover of mankind, as Giver of life and Lord.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Willingly hast Thou, O bountiful One, endured the Cross, and as almighty God Thou hast blotted out the ancient curse incurred on account of the eating [of the fruit]; therefore, O Master Christ, we hymn and venerate Thy divine and precious Sufferings, unceasingly glorifying Thy dispensation which is beyond word.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Today the memory of the passion-bearers shines forth, for they have illumination from the heavens; the choir of angels makes festival, and the human race celebrates with them; therefore they pray, O Lord, that our souls may find mercy.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *Glory; Both now: Stavrotheotokion:* [^260]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: By the Cross of Thy Son, O Lady full of divine joy, all idol deception hath been abolished, and demonic power...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...hath been trampled down; therefore do we, the faithful, ever duly hymn and bless Thee, and confessing Thee truly to be the Mother of God, we magnify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *After the 3rd Stichology, Sessional Hymn, Tone 5.*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: When the angelic ranks beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, they were struck with dread within themselves, O King of all; straightway the demonic hosts were vanquished, the bars of Hades were shattered, the tyranny of death was cast down, and the dead who were in the tombs were raised up.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Beholding Thee, O Christ, hanging willingly upon the Cross between the two thieves, Thy Mother, beating her maternal breast, cried aloud: O sinless Son, how art Thou unjustly nailed upon the Cross like an evildoer, desiring to make the human race alive, as Thou art exceedingly good!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *Canon to the Precious and Life-giving Cross, Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos: Unto the Savior God...* [^261]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: By Thine own will, O Christ, hast Thou endured the passion-slaying Passion, and hast slain him who of old slew us in paradise; therefore do we glorify Thy bounties.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and the enemy fell down, and we who were fallen were exalted and became citizens of paradise, O Christ, glorifying the dominion of Thy kingdom.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Well armed with the shield of the Cross, ye set yourselves in array against every submission unto the tormentor, O most wise great-martyrs; and having conquered him, ye received glory.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: As honorable lambs were ye offered up unto the sacrificed Lamb Who suffered for our sake, having plainly put an end to abominable sacrifices; therefore do we call you blessed, O all-praised ones.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: A new Child unto us, O pure Virgin, Him Who is Ancient of Days...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...hast Thou brought forth, Who renews aged human nature by His divine Passion, O all-immaculate one.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *Another Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos, same Heirmos:*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: A fountain of tender compassion and a fervent protectress do I know Thee to be, O all-immaculate Virgin Mother Mary; and I cry aloud unto Thee: have mercy and show compassion unto my humble soul!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Within Thy womb the Son of God took up His abode, O pure one, and assumed human nature as He is exceedingly good, and delivered all from the corruption of the serpent.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Be Thou my illumination and hope of salvation, O all-immaculate Mother of God, loosing the bonds of my transgressions, and delivering me from future torment and condemnation.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Deliver my humble soul from evil thoughts, O Mother of God, and make it a dwelling place...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...of God, that I may ever duly glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos: By the power of Thy Cross...* [^262]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Lifted up upon the Tree, O Savior, Thou causest the fruit of corruption to wither; and from Thy side Thou pourest forth unto us the fountain of incorruption, O Master.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Thou wast slaughtered like a lamb upon the Cross, marking the doorposts of our souls with Thy divine blood, O Master; therefore with fear do we glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Bound, O sufferers of Christ, and wounded in manifold ways, and cast unto beasts, ye remained unshaken.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Like clusters of the living Vine, the martyrs of Christ our God poured forth the wine of suffering, gladdening the hearts of the faithful.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Revealing Thee as mediatress of life unto us, O pure one, Thy Son and Lord appeared dead upon the Tree, glorifying...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...those who hymn Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Deliver me, who have fallen into the ruinous pit of grievous sins, O Mother of God, by Thy tender bounty!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Having arrived at the evening of my life, and being held fast by perplexity, I cry aloud unto Thee, O all-hymned one: show Thyself to be my helper!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: O holy, pure Mother of God, grant remission of my transgressions; entreat salvation and eternal joy for me!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Grant me drops of tears, O pure one, that from my heart I may drive away perplexity and unstainedly hymn Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos: I heard the report of Thee...* [^263]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: When the Sun of righteousness set upon the Cross, O Christ, Thou, the unwaning Light, didst shine forth upon us who hymn Thine exceeding condescension, O Word!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: When Thou stoodest before the tribunal of judgment...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: ...O Christ, Thou didst unjustly condemn the enemy, and wast crucified between the unjust, justifying us.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Victoriously crowned, O Lord, the sufferers put the invisible enemy to shame, and cried aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Coming together in faith, let us honor the passion-bearers as unfading flowers of the spiritual paradise and precious vessels of Christ!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: When the pure one beheld Christ upon the Cross, Whom she had brought forth, she marveled at His ineffable condescension; therefore do we glorify Thee together with Him.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ѡ҃ ѡ҃ г҃] [Кустод: ломе́а.]
items.english_text: Because of my evil deeds and many transgressions, who shall be able to appease the Judge, if not Thou, O pure one, the only protectress of sinners?

items.slavonic_text: Мно́гими мя̀ па́дша прегрѣше́нїи, и҆ грѣхы̀ порабо́тивша си дш҃ꙋ, воздви́гни си́льною твое́ю мл҃твою, и҆ раздрѣши́ мя ѿ работы̀ пречⷭтая.
items.english_text: Having fallen into many transgressions, and having enslaved my soul unto sins, raise me up by Thy mighty prayer, and loose me from bondage, O all-immaculate one.

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ро́ждшїя тво́рца и҆ цр҃я вся́ческихъ, бцⷣе всенепоро́чная чⷭтая, ты́ мя и҆зба́ви вся́каго скве́рнаго согрѣше́нїя.
items.english_text: As Thou hast brought forth the Creator and King of all, O all-immaculate, pure Mother of God, do Thou deliver me from every foul transgression.

items.slavonic_text: Себѐ сама́го пла́чꙋ, є҆гда̀ вопомышле́нїе прїидꙋ̀ мно́гихъ мѝ прегрѣше́нїй, и҆ ѻ҆гня̀ негаси́маго. и҆ молю́ся, да́ждь мѝ вре́мя покаѧ́нїа пречⷭтая.
items.english_text: I weep for myself when I come to the recollection of my many transgressions and of the unquenchable fire; and I pray: Grant me time for repentance, O all-immaculate one!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь є҃, І҆рмо́съ. Оу҆́треннююще вопїе́мъ ти гдⷭи,
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Early in the morning we cry unto Thee, O Lord...* [^264]

items.slavonic_text: Ка́менїе тя̀ на ка́мени ѡ҆щꙋти́вше воздви́женна хрⷭтѐ, распаде́ся, и҆ землѝ потрясо́шася ѡ҆снова́нїа.
items.english_text: Perceiving Thee lifted up upon the Stone, O Christ, the stones were split, and the foundations of the earth were shaken.

items.slavonic_text: Ѿложѝ свѣ́тлость сл҃нце, воздвиже́ннꙋ тѝ на дре́во, сл҃нце пра́ведное долготерпѣли́ве.
items.english_text: The sun laid aside its brightness when Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Sun of righteousness, Long-suffering One!

items.slavonic_text: чꙋде́съ блиста́ете ст҃і́и сїѧ́нїа, тмꙋ̀ ѿгонѧ́юще болѣ́зней дх҃омъ. * Мꙋ́нченъ.
items.english_text: Ye flash forth the radiant light of miracles, O holy ones, driving away the darkness of infirmities by the Spirit.

items.slavonic_text: Разсѣка́хꙋтелеса ва́ша ме́чы, дх҃ъ же́ бж҃твенныя любвѐ, несѣка́емъ и҆мѣ́сте мч҃еници. * Бг҃о:
items.english_text: Swords cut your bodies in pieces, but the spirit of divine love ye held uncut, O martyrs.

items.slavonic_text: Ви́дѣвше на крⷭтѣ̀ воздви́жена влⷣкꙋ, рыда́ющи восклица́ше, дв҃о мт҃и всенепоро́чна.
items.english_text: Beholding the Master lifted up upon the Cross, weeping, she cried aloud, the Virgin Mother all-immaculate.

items.slavonic_text: Всетеле́снꙋю мѝ ꙗ҆́звꙋ прїе́мшꙋ грѣхмѝ, бы́лїемъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́й млⷭрдїя твое́го блⷣчце.
items.english_text: Having received wounds over all my body through sins, heal me, O Sovereign Lady, by the herb of Thy tender mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Тече́нїе тлѣ́нїи дре́вле ᲂу҆ста́вила є҆сѝ бж҃веннымъ ржⷭтво́мъ, нн҃ѣ́ прегрѣше́нїй мои́хъ ᲂу҆ста́ви тече́нїе пренепоро́чная.
items.english_text: Of old Thou didst halt the flow of corruption by Thy divine childbirth; now halt the flow of my transgressions, O all-immaculate one.

items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй и҆ ᲂу҆ще́дри блⷣчце дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, и҆ и҆зба́ви ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїя, и҆ вѣ́чныѧ мꙋ́ки,
items.english_text: Have mercy and show compassion, O Sovereign Lady, upon my soul, and deliver me from condemnation and eternal torment.

items.slavonic_text: при́зри и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ши блⷣчце гла́съ мо́й, и҆ моленїа и҆зба́ви мя̀ вѣ́чнагѡ мꙋче́нїа.
items.english_text: Look upon me and give ear, O Sovereign Lady, unto my voice, and by my supplication deliver me from eternal torment.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: The abyss hath surrounded me...*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The Cross was set up upon the earth, and the fall of demons came to pass, and the confirmation of the faith received a beginning, and malice was driven away from our midst.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The sun beheld Thy Flesh ignited like a lamp upon the Tree, O Lord; and the drachma was found, which had been buried by murky passions.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: When Thou wast lifted up upon the Tree, O Lover of mankind, Thou hadst a choir of martyrs following Thy steps, imitating Thy Passion, which mediate passionlessness.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Ye dried up the torrents of delusion with streams of blood, and quenched the alien demonic fire with divine dew, O crown-bearing martyrs.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: A sword pierced Thy heart, O all-immaculate one (Luke 2:35), when Thou didst behold the Creator being crucified...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...and His divine side being pierced with a spear.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: An abyss of transgressions hath surrounded me, casting me down, O pure one, into the depth of despair; therefore lead me up from the nethermost hades, who glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Raise me up, who lie upon the bed of transgressions, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, and grant me saving enlightenment through repentance.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Purify, O Lover of mankind, by the prayers of her who purely gave Thee birth, and deliver Thy world from every affliction, and vouchsafe unto eternal glory.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Departing from communion in evil deeds, yet ever grieving my Master with falsehood, O all-immaculate Sovereign Lady, do Thou grant me amendment!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos: In the furnace of fire...* [^265]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: That we might be delivered from voluptuous sin...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...Thou didst taste gall, O Christ, Thou vital Sweetness!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: When Thou wast wounded upon the Cross, Adam's ancient wounds of many years were healed.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Having honored God with painful piety, ye obtained the supreme honor, O sufferers.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: With voluntary impulse daring unto suffering, the passion-bearers showed themselves victors.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: After childbirth, O pure one, even as before childbirth, Thou remainest; for God was Thy Child, that He might deify mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: O pure Mother of God, despise me not who ever flee with faith beneath Thy protection.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Drying up the pasture of my passions, grant me to pour forth drops of tears, O Mother of God...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...bound with the chains of sin, loose me by Thy prayers, O all-immaculate, all-hymned one who didst give birth unto God.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Unto Thee do I flee in faith, and Thee do I invoke, O pure one; deliver me, O Virgin, from eternal fire.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Him Who from the Father before the ages...* [^266]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: O exceedingly good One Who healest the curse of the tree by the Tree, and pourest forth deliverance unto mankind: Thee do we hymn, O Savior, and Thee do we glorify unto ages of ages!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: By Thy Cross Thou didst humble the exalted serpent, and didst raise up him who had fallen grievously and humbled himself: Thee do we hymn, O Savior, and Thee do we glorify unto ages of ages!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The destroyers of delusion, and ramparts of the divine faith, pillars of the Church, true solid adamants, the warriors of Christ, let us honor in faith with hymns, the passion-bearers!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The glorious passion-bearers, flashing forth like the sun, dispelled the clouds of wounds by grace, and destroyed the darkness of impiety through faith in the Trinity.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: As a bridal conductor unto Thee, O Virgin, Gabriel was sent, crying aloud unto Thee: Rejoice, O most radiant palace of Christ the King of all, dwelling wherein He deified mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Being in perplexity of both heart and mind, not fearing the chastisement of Gehenna, I sin unceasingly; but do Thou, O Virgin, resolve my perplexity, and deliver me from fire!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: By the pleasures of my flesh I am often dragged down, and like a captive I am sold, ever provoking God to anger; O Mother of God, sole hope of the hopeless, do Thou Thyself have mercy on me!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Since Thy prayer is never put to shame, O all-immaculate...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...whatsoever Thou desirest Thou grantest, entreating Thy Son and God; therefore do I pray Thee: have mercy and save my humble soul!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: By bodily sicknesses, and passionate tumults, and cruel wounds of soul I am grievously consumed; O Thou who alone didst give birth to the Benefactor, make me whole by Thy supplications!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Thee Who beyond mind...* [^267]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The strength and dominion of the enemy was taken away, O only mighty Lord, when Thou wast lifted up upon the Cross, and didst bathe Thy fingers in blood thereon.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: They pierced Thy hands and Thy feet, O my Christ, and numbered Thy bones (Psalm 21:17–19 LXX), when lawless men crucified Thee and gave Thee gall with vinegar to drink.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: With radiant mouths ye proclaimed God Who became man before the tormentors, O passion-bearers, and ye inherited glory.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The enemies were wounded with wounds when they smote you with manifold torments, O all-honored ones, physicians of wounds, divine martyrs.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Light hath shone forth unto us from Thee, O pure one, even Christ; and being crucified, He enlightened all creation and drove away ignorant darkness.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Grant me tears of repentance, O all-immaculate one, that I may weep for my cruel and unacceptable deeds before the arrival of the end of my life.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Why, O my soul, dost thou grieve thy Master, doing unrighteous deeds, and dost not look up? Before the end, make haste and repent!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Deliver me from evil transgressions and afflictions, grant me mercy, O all-honored Virgin, and divine communion of incorruptible life.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Thee who didst ineffably give birth to God have we acquired as protectress, and an invincible rampart...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...and salvation for our souls, and a fountain of miracles.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Then the Exapostilarion of the Cross:* [^268]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Rejoice, O most holy Cross, unconquerable rampart of the world, refuge of the afflicted, and guardian of those in necessities, victory for kings, preserver of soldiers, vanquisher of barbarians, crown of the apostles, and salvation of the faithful!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Beholding Thee nailed to the Cross, the all-immaculate one, weeping and lamenting, cried aloud: How hast Thou set, O Sun of glory, O primordial Light? How art Thou nailed to the Cross, and Thy ribs pierced with a spear, O my Son and God, for the sake of man's salvation?

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 5:*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: No sooner was the wood of Thy Cross set up, O Christ, than delusion was driven away and grace blossomed forth; for no longer is there condemnation of torment...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...but victory hath appeared as our salvation; for the Cross is our praise, the Cross is our confirmation, the Cross is our rejoicing!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: He was led for our sake unto the slaughter like a sheep, and as a gentle lamb, Emmanuel (Isaiah 53:7); unto voluntary slaughter He was numbered with the lawless. Come, praise Him, ye families of the nations (Psalm 21:28 LXX), and bow down before Him Who was hung upon the Cross, Life without end!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Blessed is the army of the heavenly King! For though the passion-bearers were earthborn, yet they hastened to attain angelic dignity, having no care for their bodies; and through suffering they were accounted worthy of the honor of the bodiless hosts. By their prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Standing by the Cross, O Jesus, she who gave Thee birth, weeping...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...lamented, crying aloud: I cannot endure this, seeing Thee nailed upon the Wood, Whom I brought forth, escaping pangs as having known no man; and how am I now seized with pangs, and wounded to the heart? For now is fulfilled the word which Symeon spake: A sword shall pierce Thine own heart, O undefiled one (Luke 2:35). But now, O my Son, arise and save those who hymn Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *On Friday, The Beatitudes, Tone 5:* [^269]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Recognizing Thee to be God upon the Cross, having believed in Thee, the thief confessed Thee purely from the heart, crying aloud: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy kingdom (Luke 23:42)!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Having been put to death upon the Cross, Thou didst make alive Adam who had died because of the eating, O compassionate Giver of life, and didst show him once more, O blessed One, to be an inhabitant of paradise.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Thou wast nailed to the Cross, O Christ, the true Vine (John 15:1); Thou didst pour forth the drink of salvation, watering the hearts of all the faithful with grace.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Beaten, O wise ones, and severed in twain, ye prefigured the Master's slaughter; therefore, O martyrs of Christ, ye are ever called blessed.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: We faithfully bow down before Thee, God in three Persons in one essence, unseparated, transcendent essence, crying aloud unto Thee: Glory to Thee, O Trinity, unity, our God!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Worn down with weeping, the Sovereign Lady, seeing Him Who is our Life dead voluntarily upon the wood of the Cross: therefore with divine voices do we all ever call Thee blessed.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *On Friday evening, at "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable Monks, Tone 6. Model melody: Having placed all their hope:* [^270]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Walking in the footsteps of all His sufferings, the whole martyr band set out steadfastly...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...unto many struggles; and before impious tormentors and lawless kings they proclaimed Him to be God, and endured many torments, hoping to receive heavenly honors. Whereof now beholding they rejoice, and together with the ranks of the bodiless powers, O Lord, they stand before Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The divinely chosen flock ye preserved unharmed unto the end; imitators of Christ, the Chief Shepherd (1 Peter 5:4), did ye become, O all-sacred shepherds, divine treasures of piety, having driven away the wild wolves; and well did ye lead that same flock into the heavenly fold, where, now dwelling, make remembrance of those who praise you with love, and with boldness pray Christ for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Having lived venerably, all ye venerable fathers, the demons...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...ye conquered; and having extinguished the burning assaults of passions by your sufferings, ye manfully endured, O blessed ones; and ye now rejoice with the heavenly hosts, having in the flesh lived a life assimilated to those bodiless ones; with them pray Christ, the exceedingly good God, that those who honor you may find deliverance from falls.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, denied Thee not, neither did they depart from Thy commandments; by their prayers have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Passion-bearers, martyrs, heavenly citizens, who suffered upon earth and endured many torments: by their prayers and intercession, O Lord, preserve us all.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Glory; Both now: Theotokion: Who shall not call Thee blessed... (seek in Tone 2 at Vespers)* [^271]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *On the Aposticha, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Having suffered for Thy sake, O Christ, they endured many torments...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...and received perfect crowns in the heavens, that they might pray for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Thy Cross, O Lord, became an unconquerable weapon for the martyrs; for they foresaw the death lying before them, yet looked beyond unto the life to come, strengthened by their hope in Thee; by their prayers have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
