items.english_text: My beginning and foundation was Thy creative command; for wishing to fashion me as a living creature out of invisible and visible nature, Thou didst fashion my body from the earth, and gavest me a soul by Thy divine and life-creating inbreathing; therefore, O Savior, give rest unto Thy servants in the land of the living and in the tents of the righteous!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: By the prayers of her who gave Thee birth, O Christ, of Thy martyrs, and apostles, and prophets, and hierarchs, venerable ones...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...righteous ones, and of all Thy saints: give rest unto Thy departed servants!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *On Saturday at Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 6:* [^272]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Light is ever unto the righteous (Psalm 96:11 LXX), for the holy ones, enlightened by Thee, shine ever like stars, having extinguished the lamp of the impious; by their prayers, O our Savior, do Thou enlighten my lamp, O Lord (Psalm 17:29 LXX), and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Having endured the struggle of suffering, the holy ones received crowns of victory from Thee; they abolished the plots of the lawless, and received incorruptible crowns; being entreated by them, O God, grant us great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: O Thou Who didst call Thine own Mother blessed, Thou camest unto the Passion by voluntary counsel, shining forth upon the Cross, seeking to recover Adam, saying unto the angels...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...Rejoice with Me, for the lost drachma is found (Luke 15:9)! O Thou Who hast wisely ordered all things, O God, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *After the 2nd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The sufferings of resistance at the tribunal, the tormentors' wounds inflicted upon the martyrs, while the ranks of the bodiless hosts stood by holding crowns of victory! The wise ones astonished the tormentor and the king, and cast down the apostate by the confession of Christ; O Lord Who didst strengthen them, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: O Lord, the memory of Thy saints this day is shown to be like the paradise in Eden; for therein all creation rejoiceth; and by their supplications grant us purification and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Truly all things are vanity, and life is but a shadow and a dream (Ecclesiastes 1:2); for in vain doth every...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...earthborn man disquiet himself (Psalm 38:7 LXX), as the Scripture saith: When we have gained the world, then into the grave do we take up our abode, where kings and beggars are together; therefore, O Christ God, give rest unto those who have departed, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: From the heart and from the depths of my being do I ever send sighs unto Thee; I pray for Thy favorable intercession, O all-immaculate one: have mercy on my passionate soul, entreat the merciful God to deliver me from judgment and the lake of fire, O only blessed one!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Canon to the Holy Martyrs, Hierarchs, and Venerable Monks, Tone 6. Ode 1. Heirmos: He Who marvelously drowned Pharaoh...* [^273]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: With enlightened mind ye enlightened those in darkness, and putting to shame the impious tormentors, O martyrs, ye clearly became victors and arrived unto the unwaning light.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The hierarchs of Christ and the choir of venerable ones, and the prophets...

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: ...and the united assembly of all the righteous, radiant with the beauties of virtues, entered into the heavenly mansions.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: The multitude of women, having clothed themselves in Christ, who trampled underfoot him who brought death unto Eve by cruel deception, are called blessed with divine songs for their manly labors.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: O Christ, Who in the beginning didst fashion man from the earth: we pray Thee, give rest unto the souls of Thy servants in the mansions of the righteous, in places of refreshment, as Thou art good.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: More holy than the Cherubim and Seraphim wast Thou shown to be, O pure one, having given birth to the Creator of creation; unceasingly pray Him to show compassion unto Thy servants who glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: *Another Canon for the Departed, Tone 8 [Tone 6], Ode 1. Heirmos: Having traversed the water...* [^274]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́. Ѡ҆бы́йде мя̀ бе́здна.
items.english_text: Imitating Christ's death by death, and His Passion by passions...

items.slavonic_text: дража́юще чⷭтно́ю мч҃нци, вен бж҃тве́нныя и҆ бл҃же́нныя жи́зни полꙋчи́ша. Пок
items.english_text: ...honorably imitating the death of Christ by their death and His passion by their passions, the martyrs received crowns of divine and blessed life.

items.slavonic_text: Ю́ности согрѣше́нїа пре́зря, и҆ грѣхѝ преходя̀ х҃е сп҃се: пре́жде ᲂу҆со́пшихъ ра̑бъ твои́хъ, со и҆збра́нными твои́ми причтѝ.
items.english_text: Overlooking the sins of youth and passing over transgressions, O Christ Savior: number Thy previously departed servants with Thine elect.

items.slavonic_text: Е҆́яже полꙋчи́ша сла́вы же и҆ ра́дости, и҆̀же бл҃же́ное стяжа́вшїи пребыва́нїе, пода́ждь бога́тно твои́мъ рабѡ́мъ, и҆́хже прїя́лъ многоми́лостиве. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: Of the glory and joy that they who attained the blessed abode have received, grant richly, O Most-Merciful One, unto Thy servants whom Thou hast taken to Thyself.

items.slavonic_text: Зачала̀ є҆сѝ сло́во ѿч҃ее, пло́тїю соедини́вша ся ѿрокови́це, и҆́же а҆́да бж҃твенною си́лою ᲂу҆праздни́вшаго.
items.english_text: Thou didst conceive the Word of the Father, Who united with flesh, O Maiden, and abolished Hades by His divine power.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́ г҃, І҆рмо́. На тве́рдемъ вѣ́ры твое́я ка́мени.
items.english_text: Upon the firm rock of Thy faith...

items.slavonic_text: Теле́снымъ примѣси́вшеся болѣ́знемъ страда́лцы, неболѣ́зненное взира́хꙋ воздая́нїе ра́дꙋющеся, и҆ нн҃ѣ ᲂу҆ставля́ютъ на́ша болѣ́зни безчи́сленныя бл҃гтїю.
items.english_text: Muffled in bodily afflictions, the passion-bearers looked rejoicing toward the painless recompense; and now by grace they stay our countless afflictions.

items.slavonic_text: лꙋка́выѧ, бж҃твеннїи страстоно́сци, и҆зба́виша невреди́мыхъ тѣ́хъ ѡ҆ѕлобле́нїа, хв҃ы ѡ҆́вца бж҃твенныя.
items.english_text: By steadfast character driving away the cunning beast,

items.slavonic_text: Во́лею и҆́го гдⷭне под̾е́мше ли́къ прпⷡныхъ, ᲂу҆мертви́вый мꙋдрова́нїе плотско́е, и҆ живо́тъ вѣ́чный воспрїя́тъ. Пок.
items.english_text: the divine passion-bearers delivered unharmed the divine sheep of Christ from their malice.

items.slavonic_text: И҆зба́ви х҃е ѻ҆гня̀ вѣ́чнаго, бл҃гоче́стно ѿ житїя̀ преста́вльшыяся, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе да́ждь долго́въ и҆̀хъ бл҃же, и҆ црⷭтвїа наслажде́нїе.
items.english_text: Having willingly taken up the yoke of the Lord, the choir of the venerable put to death the carnal mind and received life everlasting.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же х҃а возлюби́вшїя же́ны, та́иже того̀ неизрече́нно ро́ждшꙋ прⷭтая влⷣчце, ра́достною мы́слїю предстоя́ще ликовствꙋ́ютъ. И҆́нъ І҆рмо́. Нбⷭномꙋ крꙋгꙋ.
items.english_text: Deliver, O Christ, from eternal fire those who have departed from this life in piety, and grant them remission of their debts, O Good One, and the enjoyment of the Kingdom.

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆чи́щшеся дре́вняго прароди́телнаго паде́нїа, кр҃ще́нїемъ и҆ порожде́нїемъ, стрꙋя́ми же кро́вїй свои́хъ ѡ҆кропи́вшеся, со хрⷭто́мъ бл҃же́ннїи црⷭтвꙋютъ. Поко́й.
items.english_text: The women who loved Christ stand before Thee with joyful mind, O all-holy Sovereign Lady, and dance in choir before her who ineffably gave birth to Him.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O Lord, Builder of the vault of heaven...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Purified from the ancient primal fall through baptism and regeneration, and sprinkled with the streams of their own blood, the blessed martyrs reign with Christ.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: *For the Departed:* [^275]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O Savior Who didst willingly lie dead in the grave and didst raise up those dwelling in the tombs: be well pleased that those whom Thou hast taken from us should settle in the tents of Thy saints.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Being entreated, O Master, by Thy divine compassions and the goodness known to be connate unto Thee: grant remission of transgressions unto Thy servants, and give them rest with Thyself.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Incarnate from thy womb and having become man, He Who is preeminently the only Lover of mankind saves man from the gates of death, O all-holy Mother of God, only all-praised one.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: I heard, O Lord, Thy report...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Standing firm, the passion-bearers watched the proud adversary being cut down beneath their loins, and in every way they thankfully glorified the Creator.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The holy ones, guiding men by the voice of radiance unto the light of understanding, dispelled the darkness of heresies.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Ye appeared like burning coals through fervent union with God, and ye burn up material passions, O venerable ones, and are greatly glorified.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Ruling over the living and the dead, O Lord: give rest unto those whom Thou hast translated, with all who have been well-pleasing unto Thee, O Master.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: When the Lord was ineffably clothed in flesh from thee, O all-pure one: women, having struggled with manly courage, were brought unto Him.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou art my Lord, O Christ...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: That they might behold Thy glory, O Master, and brightly obtain Thy light-bestowing rays in the heavens: bearing the wounds of tortures, the divine martyrs endured, singing unto Thee, O Christ: [^276]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: ...singing: "Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Many are the mansions with Thee, O Savior, apportioned worthily unto all according to the measure of their virtues: make those who have faithfully departed worthy to be filled with them, O Compassionate One, as they piously cry unto Thee: "Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou didst appear as a man like unto us, O Savior of the whole world; Thou didst endure death equally for all and didst show forth the way of life: vouchsafe the departed to partake thereof as Lover of mankind, granting remission of sins as Master, and bestowing communion in light.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou art the praise of the faithful, O unwedded Bride; thou art the protectress, the refuge of Christians, a rampart and a haven: thou bearest supplications unto Thy Son, O all-immaculate one, and

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: deliverest from tribulations those who know thee in faith and love to be the pure Mother of God.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou Who didst shine forth light upon the whole world...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Clothed in the vesture of grace woven from on high, O passion-bearers, ye stripped the enemy bare.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: With the holy prophets, let us honor the divinely wise high priests and the venerable who were well-pleasing unto God.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: In psalms and hymns, let us praise the choir of women, as having been well-pleasing unto God.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Appoint Thy servants, O Lord, in the tents of Thy righteous ones, overlooking the sins they committed in this life.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Show thyself delivering us from every harm of the enemy, O Sovereign Lady, praying unto Christ, the only Compassionate One.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Why hast Thou cast me off... [^277]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: In Thine ineffable glory and Thy beatitude surpassing all speech, in the dwellings of the righteous where the voice of those who feast is sweet: have compassion, O only Lover of mankind, and vouchsafe the departed unto immortal life.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Where angelic orders and assemblies of the righteous rejoice: settle Thy servants in the bosom of Abraham, O Savior, and be well-pleased, O Compassionate One, that they may stand with boldness before Thy fearful and divine throne.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou didst appear unto us as purification, righteousness, and redemption; by Thy wound Thou hast healed our infirmities: do Thou Thyself, O Compassionate One, as Good, establish the departed in the delight of paradise.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Mercifully, O Compassionate One, Thou didst assume the measure of humanity, adorning it with elevations surpassing divine glory:

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: taking from virginal loins flesh ensouled and endowed with reason, whereby Thou hast destroyed death.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Swallowed by the whale...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: By the stream of your divine blood, ye drowned spiritual foes, O passion-bearers, and watered the hearts of the faithful.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Having crucified yourselves unto the world and passions, O venerable ones and wise hierarchs: ye were accounted worthy of divine glory.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Duly we bless the prophetic choir and the honorable assembly of those who fought the good fight.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Give rest, O God, unto the souls of those previously fallen asleep, together with Thine elect, overlooking their transgressions.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O thou who didst bear Christ in the flesh: put to death the passions of my flesh, and quicken my soul, O Virgin, through thy intercession... [^278]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: ...through thy maternal intercession.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Cleanse me, O Savior...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Having endured many tortures, O Savior, Thy holy martyrs, their souls wounded with Thy love, yearned for Thine everlasting glory and sweet communion with Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou didst tear apart the belly of hostile death, O Savior, and didst raise up all the prisoners held therein, bestowing life: vouchsafe the departed to partake thereof, O Benefactor.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Deliver Thy servants from the tears and sighing in Hades, O Savior, as the only Merciful One: Thou Who hast taken away every tear from every face of those who faithfully confess Thee as God.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: He Who is Creator by nature is created in thy womb; He Who is full as God empties Himself, O all-immaculate one, the only Immortal One, Who for the sake of all dies a saving death.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The holy children in the furnace...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Let us honor with songs the passion-bearers of Christ, who quenched the flame of grievous godlessness with showers of blood.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The glorious hierarchs, having destroyed the winter of heresies, came rejoicing unto the divine springtime.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: By endurance ye inherited the rich grace of the Spirit, O desert-dwellers, and destroyed the multitude of demons.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Vouchsafe the departed in faith from this life to inherit the food of paradise, O Compassionate and Most-Merciful One.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: He Who preserved thee a Virgin even after childbirth, O pure one, has saved the choirs of holy women who followed thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The Hebrew children in the furnace...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: All the longing of the martyrs was extended toward the one Master... [^279]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: ...united unto that Master by love, and singing: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou dost grant unto those who have departed in faith the radiance of the divine Kingdom, bestowing a garment of incorruption as they sing: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Fill with joy and gladness Thy servants whom Thou hast translated, O Compassionate One, and make them worthy to cry out and sing unto Thee: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, unto ages!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Having dissolved the curse of Eve, Thou didst dwell within the all-immaculate Virgin, welling forth a spring of blessing unto those who cry: "Blessed, O all-pure one, is the fruit of thy womb!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The holy children in Babylon...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Valiantly wounded by the tempest of tortures, the divine martyrs passed through by grace into profound stillness, and reached the Kingdom on high.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The all-wise venerable holy ones, appearing like the sun, illumine the universe with the rays of their teachings and the brilliancy of their healings.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O glorious prophets and high priests, all ye venerable and righteous ones, and multitude of martyrs and women: preserve your whole flock unshaken from demons.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Let us hymn the righteous from the ages and the divinely-speaking prophets, and let us cry out with compunction: By their prayers, O Word, give rest unto those who have fallen asleep in faith.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Knowing thee, O Virgin, to be the closest beauty of God, the choir of women loved thee, and following after thee were brought unto the Master, harmoniously blessing thee, O all-pure one.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: In the martyrs' fire...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Having passed through earthly passions, the true martyrs received heavenly crowns, crying: [^280]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: ...crying unto the Savior: "Praise the Lord and exalt Him above all forever!"

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Having descended into the nethermost pit, Thou didst raise up those dwelling in the tombs by Thy life-originating hand: grant rest, O Compassionate One, unto Thy servants who have previously fallen asleep in faith.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: As a fountain of everlasting life, as a torrent of delight: water Thy servants who have piously departed unto Thee, as they sing and exalt Thee, O Christ, unto the ages.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O Mary, Mother of God and Virgin, who didst bear in the flesh God the Savior unto men: save those who in faith hymn thy childbearing and exalt thee, the pure one, unto all ages.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: She that received the joy through the angel...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Offered as pure sacrifices unto the Master, O passion-bearing martyrs: pray unto Him that He may save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: As shepherds on the pasture of piety, O hierarchs, ye shepherded the faithful, and now ye have settled in the divine sheepfold.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: With the holy hierarchs and prophets, and with the women who suffered valiantly, let us bless the choirs of the venerable.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Vouchsafe the departed to attain the everlasting gladness whereof the assemblies of the saints partake, O Most-Merciful One.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O thou who didst bring forth the Light: illumine my soul, O Virgin, driving away the darkness of sin and of my slothfulness.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Every ear shuddered...

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Possessing unconquerable and invincible strength, O martyrs of Christ: ye brought to naught the godless decree of the tormentors, and were accounted worthy of the glory of the heavenly Kingdom, illumined by the rays of the Trinity, O ever-blessed ones. [^281]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Bitter Hades was destroyed when Thou didst pull it down, O Lover of mankind, and didst resurrect those sleeping there from the ages. Now also, as Good, vouchsafe Thy never-setting light unto those who have departed unto Thee, the Compassionate One.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou art all sweetness, O my Savior, Thou art all longing and truly insatiable love, Thou art all ineffable beauty: be well-pleased that those who have departed unto Thee may enjoy Thy beauty, and vouchsafe them Thy divine loveliness.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Save me, O Mother of God, who didst bear Christ my Savior, both God and man, twofold in nature but not in person, only-begotten of the Father, and from thee first-born of all creation; therefore we all magnify thee, O pure one.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O glorious prophets, blessed apostles, righteous patriarchs, sole solemn assembly of hierarchs, venerable, righteous, and choir of women, holy martyrs: with the Mother of God, pray unto the Lord to have mercy on your servants.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: *Another Exapostilarion for the Departed:*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O Thou Who rulest over the dead and the living as God: give rest unto Thy servants in the dwellings of Thine elect; for even though all have sinned, yet they fell not away from Thee.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O sweetness of the angels, and joy of the sorrowful, protectress of Christians, Virgin Mother of the Lord: intercede for us and deliver us from eternal torments.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: *At the Praises, Stichera of the Martyrs, Tone 6:*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O Lord, in the memory of Thy saints all creation keeps feast; the heavens rejoice with the angels, and the earth makes merry with men: by their prayers have mercy on us. [^282]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: O Lord, if we had not Thy saints as intercessors, and Thy grace showing mercy upon us, how should we dare, O Savior, to hymn Thee, Whom the angels unceasingly glorify? O Knower of hearts, spare our souls! (Martyrikon)

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: The memory of the martyrs is joy unto those who fear the Lord; for having suffered for the sake of Christ, they received crowns from Him, and now with boldness they pray for our souls.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Our God made marvelous His chosen and holy ones: rejoice and be glad, all ye His servants, for He has prepared for you a crown and His Kingdom; but we pray you, forget not us also.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Grief came upon Adam through the tasting of the tree of old in Eden, when the serpent vomited forth venom; for on account of that, universal death entered, devouring man. But the Master came and cast down the serpent, and granted us the Resurrection: unto Him therefore let us cry aloud: Spare, O Savior, and give rest with the saints unto those whom Thou hast taken to Thyself, as Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou art our God, Who in wisdom hast made all things and dost bring them to completion: Thou didst send prophets to foretell Thy coming, and apostles to proclaim Thy marvelous works; and while the former prophesied Thy coming, the latter illumined the nations through baptism; and the martyrs obtained what they desired; and the assembly of both, together with her who gave birth to Thee, O Christ, prays unto Thee: Give rest, O God, unto the souls of those whom Thou hast taken to Thyself, and make us worthy of Thy Kingdom, O Thou Who didst endure crucifixion for my sake, the condemned one, my Deliverer and God!

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Penitential Stichera, Tone 6, model melody: "Having placed all their hope":*

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Possessing incomprehensible compassion toward us, and an inexhaustible fountain of divine goodness... [^283]

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: ...goodness, O Most-Merciful One: settle those who have passed over unto Thee, O Master, in the land of the living, the beloved and desired habitations, granting an inheritance that abides forever; for Thou didst shed Thy blood for all, O Savior, and by that life-bearing price hast redeemed the world.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou didst endure death by Thy life-creating will, and didst pour forth life, and gavest everlasting food unto the faithful: grant it now also unto those who have fallen asleep in the hope of the Resurrection, forgiving all their sins in Thy goodness, as the only Sinless One, the only Good One and Lover of mankind; that for all things Thy name may be hymned, O Christ, and that we, being saved, may glorify Thy love for mankind.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Exercising lordship over the living by Thy divine originating authority, and ruling as Master over the dead: knowing Thee, O Christ, we pray Thee:

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: give rest unto Thy faithful servants who have departed unto Thee, the only Benefactor, together with Thine elect, O Lover of mankind, in the place of comfort, in the brightness of the saints; for Thou art the willer of mercy, and as God Thou savest those whom Thou hast created in Thine own image, O only Most-Merciful One.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: Thou appearedst as a divinely fitting habitation, O all-pure one, and didst contain God, having given birth to Christ, O Virgin Mother, in two natures, yet in one person: entreat Him, O pure one, the only-begotten Firstborn, Who preserved thee a blameless Virgin even after childbirth: to give rest unto the souls of those who have fallen asleep in faith, in the light and incorruptible beatitude.

items.slavonic_text: [Сигнатура: Ъ҃ Ъ҃ г҃] [Кустод: И҆́же]
items.english_text: *On Saturday, the Beatitudes, Tone 6:* [^284]

items.slavonic_text: [П]омяни́ мѧ̀ бж҃е сп҃се мо́й, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши во црⷭтвїи свое́мъ, и҆ сп҃си мя̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: Remember me, O God my Savior, when Thou comest into Thy Kingdom, and save me, as the only Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆гня̀ и҆ меча̀, и҆ ѕвѣре́й ди́вїихъ ᲂу҆стремле́нїа, страстоте́рпци сла́вні́и не ᲂу҆боя́стеся, присносꙋ́щнаго живота̀ сподо́бистеся.
items.english_text: Of the fire, the sword, and the rushing of wild beasts, O glorious passion-bearers, ye were not afraid; and ye were accounted worthy of life everlasting.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же прⷪрки, и҆ ᲂу҆ч҃тля и҆ прпⷣбныя, и҆ ст҃и́теля и҆ пра́ведныя просла́вивъ чл҃колю́бче, тѣ́хъ мл҃твами сп҃си дꙋ́ша на́ша.
items.english_text: Thou Who didst glorify prophets, and teachers, and the venerable, and hierarchs, and the righteous, O Lover of mankind: by their prayers save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Со ст҃ы́ми и҆ пра́ведными ᲂу҆чинѝ сло́ве, и҆́хже вѣ́рою преста́вилъ є҆сѝ ѿ вре́менныхъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да сла́вимъ тя̀. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: Rank with the saints and the righteous, O Word, those whom in faith Thou hast translated from temporal things, that we may glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ сн҃а славосло́вимъ, и҆ дх҃а ст҃а́го гл҃юще, трⷪце ст҃а́я сп҃си дꙋша нашѧ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: We glorify the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, saying: O Holy Trinity, save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Блаже́нна вовсѣ́хъ ро́дѣхъ ꙗ҆ви́лася є҆сѝ, бг҃а бо воисти́ннꙋ бл҃же́ннаго несказа́нно породи́ла є҆сѝ прⷭтая.
items.english_text: Blessed hast thou appeared in all generations, for truly ineffably didst thou bear God the Blessed One, O all-holy Lady.

items.slavonic_text: [Орнаментальная заставка и ксилографическая рамка]
items.english_text: *The Resurrectional Exapostilaria and Evangelical Stichera. The work of Emperor Leo.* [^285]

items.slavonic_text: и҆ стїхи̑ры є҆ѵаггⷭльскїа. творе́нїе Ле́ѵа деспо́та.
items.english_text: With the disciples let us ascend the mountain of Galilee in faith, to behold Christ saying that He received authority over the things above and below: let us learn how to teach and to baptize all the nations in the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, and to abide with the disciples, as He promised, unto the end of the age.

items.slavonic_text: [С]о ᲂу҆ч҃нки взы́ндемъ на́горꙋ галиле́йскꙋю вѣ́рою, х҃а ви́дѣти, глаго́люща вла́сть прїя́ти вы́шнихъ и҆ ни́жнихъ: наꙋчи́мся, ка́ко ᲂу҆чи́ти крⷭти́ти ꙗ҆зы́ки вся̑, во и҆́мя ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃а́го дх҃а. и҆ пребыва́ти со ᲂу҆ч҃нки, ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆бѣща́ся до сконча́нїа вѣ́ка. Бг҃о.
items.english_text: He Who is divinely glorified in the highest by the angels, not departing ineffably from the bosom of the Father, O all-holy Virgin, and lived among those below...

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...lived: and thou, having received Him as the Mediator of salvation, from thy pure blood didst lend flesh beyond understanding unto the Redeemer: pray Him to grant deliverance from transgressions unto thy servants.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: When the disciples were going up to the mountain for the earthly ascension, the Lord stood before them; and they worshipped Him, and they are sent forth throughout the universe under heaven to preach the resurrection from the dead and the ascension into the heavens; with whom Christ God, the Savior of our souls, promised without falsehood to abide.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Seeing the stone rolled away, the myrrh-bearing women rejoiced; for they beheld a young man sitting in the tomb, and he said unto them: "Behold, Christ is risen! Say therefore unto Peter and to the disciples:

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Hasten to the mountain of Galilee; there shall He appear unto you, as He foretold unto His friends."

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: The Sun shone forth from the tomb today as a bridegroom from his chamber, and led Hades captive, and abolished death: by the prayers of her who bare Thee, O Christ, send forth light upon us, light enlightening hearts and souls, light leading all of us inward and guiding us unto the paths of Thy commandments and unto the way of humility.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Unto the women who came with myrrh together with Mary, and were in perplexity how they might attain their desire, the stone appeared rolled away; and a divine young man assuaged the turmoil of their souls, for he said: "The Lord is risen; therefore hasten to Galilee unto His preachers, the disciples, and behold Him... [^286]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...raised from the dead, as Giver of life and Lord."

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Let no one disbelieve that Christ is risen! For He appeared unto Mary, and then was seen by two walking into the country; and He appeared again unto the eleven as they sat at meat, whom He sent forth to baptize, and ascended into heaven whence He had descended, confirming their preaching with many signs.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: By essential properties, O Virgin, Thy Son awoke from sleep as one dead, and rose as God; for He saw no corruption. Entreat Him unceasingly, O pure Lady, to send down light upon us, Thy people and Thy flock: save from daytime and nighttime stumbling us who worship Him together with the Father and the Spirit, one God.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: When Mary Magdalene announced the Savior's resurrection from the dead and His appearance, the disciples, disbelieving, were reproached for their hardness of heart; yet, being filled with signs and wonders, they were sent forth to preach. But Thou, O Lord, didst ascend unto the Father, the primal Light; and they proclaimed the Word everywhere, confirmed by wonders. And having been enlightened through them, we glorify Thy resurrection from the dead, O Lord, Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Having shone forth in virtues, let us behold standing in the life-bearing tomb men in gleaming raiment; and as the myrrh-bearing women bowed their faces to the earth before Him Who ruleth the heavens, let us learn of the resurrection, and run with Peter to the life-bearing tomb... [^287]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...and marveling at what was done, let us remain to behold Christ.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Having become incarnate in thy womb, O Lord, willing to call back from corruption a fallen world, as He alone knoweth, He dwelt in thee, O Mother of God; and having all found salvation, we cry unto thee like the angel: Rejoice, only pure Lady, blessed among all women, for thou didst bear salvation unto the whole universe!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: It was early morning, and the women came unto Thy tomb, O Christ, but the body desired by them was not found. Therefore, as they were in perplexity, two men stood by them in gleaming raiment, saying: "Why seek ye the living among the dead? He is risen, as He said before! Why remember ye not His words?" And believing them, they proclaimed what they had seen; but their glad tidings seemed an idle tale:

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: so slumbering were the disciples still! But Peter ran and beheld, and glorified within himself Thy wonders.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Christ, the Life and the Way, rose from the dead: journeying on the road with Cleopas and Luke, He was made known unto them in Emmaus in the breaking of bread; whose hearts and souls were burning when He spoke unto them on the way and expounded from the Scriptures what He had suffered; with them we also cry: "He hath appeared also unto Peter!"

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: The Creator and Lord and God of all things, taking earthly flesh from thy pure blood, O all-praised Mother of God, made my corrupted nature new, leaving thee after childbearing again even as thou wast before childbirth: therefore we all praise thee in faith, crying: Rejoice, glory of the world!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: *Evangelical Sticheron 5, Tone 5:* [^288]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: O how wise are Thy judgments, O Christ! How unto Peter indeed by the graveclothes alone Thou gavest to understand Thy resurrection; yet walking on the way with Luke and Cleopas, Thou didst converse with them, and speaking, didst not quickly reveal Thyself. Therefore Thou wast reproached as one journeying alone in Jerusalem, not knowing her counsel unto the end. Yet disposing all things for the benefit of the creation, Thou didst unfold the prophecies concerning Thyself, and in the blessing of the bread wast made known unto them, whose hearts even before that were kindled unto the knowledge of Thee; and they openly proclaimed Thy resurrection unto the assembled disciples: through whom have mercy upon us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Thou didst show Thyself, O Savior, as man by nature, standing in their midst when Thou didst rise from the tomb; and partaking of food, Thou didst teach the baptism of repentance:

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: and straightway Thou didst ascend unto the heavenly Father, and didst promise to send the Comforter unto the disciples: O supremely divine Lover of mankind, glory to Thy rising!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Beholding her Son risen from the dead, the all-holy Virgin was filled with joy, and praised His ineffable lovingkindness; for, not having departed from the Father's bosom, and born of thee, by His passion on the Cross He released all from corruption, and led back to life His own infant creature.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Truly Thou art peace, O Christ, granting Thy peace of God unto men; after the resurrection showing Thyself unto the disciples, Thou didst find them terrified, supposing that they beheld a spirit; but Thou didst quell the turmoil of their souls, showing them Thy hands and Thy feet... [^289]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...yet while they still disbelieved, by the partaking of food and the recalling of teachings Thou didst open their mind to understand the Scriptures; and having promised them the Father's promise, and blessed them, Thou didst ascend into heaven: therefore with them we worship Thee: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Saying that they had taken away the Lord, Mary ran to the tomb, and Simon Peter and the other disciple of Christ whom He loved ran with her: and both ran together, and found only the linen clothes lying within, and the napkin for the head was apart from them. Therefore they held their peace again until they beheld Christ.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Sing of Thy countless mercy, O my Savior, for Thou didst pour Thyself out to bear and to save

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: the fallen nature of earthly beings: being God, Thou wast pleased to become like me from the pure Virgin Maiden of God, and to descend into Hades, and to lead me forth thence: by her prayers, O Lord, save our souls!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Lo, it is dark and early: why standest thou at the tomb, O Mary, having great darkness in thy mind, asking where Jesus was laid? But look upon the disciples running together: how by the linen clothes and the napkin they came to know of the resurrection, and remembered the Scriptures concerning them! With whom and for whose sake having believed, we hymn Thee, O Christ Giver of life.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Beholding two angels within the tomb, Mary was amazed; and not knowing Christ, she questioned Him as the gardener: "Sir, where hast thou laid the body of my Jesus?" But having recognized Him by His call... [^290]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...within herself, she heard the Savior say: "Touch Me not, for I ascend unto My Father: say unto My brethren!"

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Not having left the Father's bosom, though He became incarnate of the Virgin, the Lord came down, bowing the heavens, to save me who was fallen, and desiring to snatch me from the mouth of the intelligible beast, held fast in his bonds: therefore, having been delivered, O Savior, I glorify Thy power.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Not without reason were Mary's warm tears poured forth: for lo, she was accounted worthy of the instruction of angels and the vision of Jesus Himself! Yet still she thought earthly thoughts, being frail: therefore she was sent away not to touch Christ. But nevertheless she was sent as a herald unto Thy disciples, bearing the glad tidings unto them,

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: announcing Thine ascent unto the Father's portion: and by these things vouchsafe Thine appearance unto us also, O Master and Lord!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: When Thou camest in, O Master, the doors being shut, Thou didst fill the apostles with the All-Holy Spirit, breathing peace upon them, unto whom Thou saidst to bind and to loose sins; and after eight days Thou didst show Thy side and hands unto Thomas, with whom we also cry: "Thou art my Lord and my God!"

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: O Birthgiver of God, pure and all-holy Virgin, Joy of the afflicted, Protection of the world, Intercessor for sinners: by thy prayers console the hearts of the sorrowful; for we the faithful have no other hope after God besides thee, O pure Mother, our hope loving mankind, and thou savest the world, O Maiden.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: *Evangelical Sticheron 9, Tone 5:* [^291]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: As in the latter times, on the evening of the Sabbath, Thou didst appear unto Thy friends, O Christ, and by a wonder didst confirm a wonder: entering through shut doors, Thou didst confirm Thy resurrection from the dead! But Thou didst fill the disciples with joy, and didst bestow upon them the Holy Spirit, and gavest authority for the remission of sins; and Thou didst not leave Thomas to drown in the tempest of unbelief: therefore grant unto us true understanding and remission of transgressions, O tender-hearted Lord!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: At the Sea of Tiberias of old, with the sons of Zebedee, Nathanael was with Peter, and two other disciples, engaged in fishing; who at Christ's bidding cast the net on the right side, and drew out a multitude of fishes:

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: whom Peter recognizing, waded toward Him. Behold, this was the third time He appeared, showing bread and fish upon the coals.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Venerating thine honorable icon, O all-holy Lady, show us to be sons of light, and dwellers of Paradise, and partakers of the Kingdom: for we are thy suppliants and thy people, O all-pure one; let us not fall from thy protection, O Good Lady, and account us worthy of the portion of all the saved, O all-immaculate Virgin.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: After the descent into Hades and the resurrection from the dead, grieving as was meet over parting from Thee, O Christ, the disciples returned to work, and again took to the boat and nets; and of catch there was nothing! But Thou, O Savior, didst appear as Master of all, commanding to cast the net on the right side; and immediately the word became deed... [^292]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...swiftly, and a great multitude of fishes, and a strange supper prepared on the earth! Of which Thy disciples then partook: vouchsafe us also now to be spiritually filled, O Lord Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: After the divine rising, thrice the Lord said unto Peter: "Lovest thou Me?" proposing him as chief shepherd over His sheep. When Peter beheld following him him whom Jesus loved, he questioned the Master: "And what shall this man do?" "If I will," He said, "that he tarry till I come again, what is that to thee, friend Peter?"

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Rejoice! we cry unto thee, O all-holy Mother of God, for thou didst announce joy unto Eve, turning sorrow into joy, O Virgin: and fill us with thy joy, and account us worthy of the radiant glory of thy Son and the portion of all the elect,

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: O all-pure one, that we all may cry unto thee: Rejoice, pure Maiden!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Manifesting Himself unto the disciples after the resurrection, the Savior gave unto thee, Simon, the pasturing of His sheep as a recompense for love, requiring care of the flock; therefore He said unto thee: "If thou lovest Me, Peter, feed My lambs, feed My sheep." Whereupon, straightway showing his brotherly love, he questioned concerning the other disciple: by whose prayers, O Christ, preserve Thy flock from the wolves that destroy it!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: *Triadika of the days, which are chanted in the Holy Forty Days and other fasts when Alleluia is chanted; then Triadikon, Tone 1:*

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: In the bodily configurations of the bodiless hosts, being led up in mind to the intelligible and immaterial... [^293]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: ...mind, and receiving the illumination of the thrice-holy hymn of the tri-hypostatic Godhead, cherubically we cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: With all the heavenly powers, cherubically sending up thrice-holy praise unto Him Who is in the highest, we cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Having risen from sleep, we fall down before Thee, O Good One, and we cry unto Thee the angelic hymn, O Almighty One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Thou Who hast shone forth the light, O Lord, cleanse my soul from every sin, and through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: O uncreated Nature, Creator of all, open our lips that we may proclaim Thy praise,

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: crying: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Imitating the powers on high on earth, we offer Thee the triumphal hymn, O Good One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: From the bed and sleep Thou hast raised me up, O Lord; enlighten my mind and heart, and open my lips to hymn Thee, O Holy Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: Send forth Thy light everlasting, O Lord, and enlighten the secret eyes of my heart: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-
items.english_text: The unoriginate Father, and the co-unoriginate Son, and the co-eternal Spirit, one Godhead, daring to glorify in cherubic praise, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же ввы́шнихъ сла́вимый бж҃твеннѣ ѿ а҆́гг҃лъ, ѿ нѣ́дръ ѻ҆тч҃ескихъ прⷭтая не ѿстꙋ́пль неизрече́нно, и҆ сни́жними пожи-

Тр҃це є҆диносꙋ́щнаѧ и҆ нераздѣ́лнаѧ, є҆дини́це трисоста́внаѧ, и҆ соприсносꙋ́щнаѧ: тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ бг҃ꙋ а҆́гглскꙋю пѣ́снь вопїе́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃тва́ми всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ.
items.english_text: O Trinity consubstantial and undivided, Monad tri-hypostatic and co-eternal: unto Thee as God we cry the angelic hymn: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Напра́сно сꙋдїѧ̀ прїи́детъ, и҆ кого́ждо дѣѧ́нїа ѡ҆бнажа́тсѧ, но со стра́хомъ возопїи́ дꙋшѐ въ полꙋ́нощи: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е: мл҃тва́ми бц҃а поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Suddenly the Judge shall come, and each one's deeds shall be laid bare; but with fear cry out in the midnight, O my soul: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Послѝ свѣ́тъ тво́й хрⷭтѐ бж҃е, и҆ просвѣти́ срⷣце моѐ: застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тныхъ твои́хъ спасѝ мѧ̀.
items.english_text: Send forth Thy light, O Christ God, and enlighten my heart: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, save me.

items.slavonic_text: Безна́чалнаго тѝ ѿц҃а, и҆ тебѐ хрⷭтѐ бж҃е, и҆ прⷭты́й тво́й дх҃ъ, херꙋви́мски славослови́ти дерза́юще гле́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: Thine unoriginate Father, and Thee, O Christ God, and Thy Most-Holy Spirit, daring cherubically to glorify, we say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ чи́ны нн҃ѣ а҆́гглстїи на нб҃се́хъ, и҆ стоя́нїа со стра́хомъ чл҃чскаѧ на землѝ, побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь прино́симъ тѝ бл҃же: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ бж҃е, мл҃твами всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. И҆ нн҃ѣ,
items.english_text: As now the angelic ranks in the heavens, and human assemblies with fear upon the earth, we offer Thee the triumphal hymn, O Good One: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Мы́сленыхъ твои́хъ слꙋ́гъ, прино́симъ тѝ мертве́ннїи пѣ́снь, дерза́юще гле́мъ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, є҆сѝ б҃е, бц҃а ра́ди поми́лꙋй на́съ.
items.english_text: Unto Thy noetic servants, we mortal ones offer Thee hymnody, daring to say: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́же свѣ́тъ возсїѧ́вый мї́рꙋ своемꙋ̀, во тмѣ̀ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆держи́мꙋ ѿ всѧ́каго грѣха̀ ѡ҆чи́сти: застꙋпле́нїемъ безпло́тныхъ твои́хъ поми́лꙋй на́съ. Тро́ич҃ Гла́съ є҆҃.
items.english_text: Thou Who hast shone forth the light unto Thy world, cleanse my soul held fast in darkness from every sin: through the intercession of Thy bodiless hosts, have mercy on us.

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́нїи вре́мѧ, и҆ мл҃твѣ ча́съ, прилѣ́жно возопїе́мъ є҆ди́номꙋ бг҃ꙋ: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆си бж҃е. Сла́ва.
items.english_text: *Triadika, Tone 5:* [^295]

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: It is the time of singing, and the hour for prayer: fervently let us cry unto the one God: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Daring to emulate Thy noetic armies...

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: ...armies, O unoriginate Trinity, with unworthy lips we cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Contained in the virgin womb, and not parted from the Father's bosom, with the angels receive also us, O Christ God, who cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: O Giver of light, Lord, send forth Thy light, and enlighten my heart: by the prayers of Thy bodiless hosts, save me.

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: With bodiless lips, with unceasing doxologies, the six-winged ones sing unto Thee the thrice-holy hymn, O our God; and we upon the earth with unworthy lips send up praise unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Standing before Thee with fear the Cherubim, and dreading with trembling the Seraphim, offer the thrice-holy hymn with unceasing voice; with whom also we sinners cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: The Trinity, a Monad in Godhead, the unconfused Unity let us glorify, and let us cry aloud the angelic hymn: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Through the intercession of the bodiless hosts, O Lord, send down upon our souls Thy light everlasting.

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: *Triadika, Tone 7:* [^296]

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Unapproachable in Godhead, Who art in the Unity of the Trinity, sending up the Seraphic thrice-holy praise, with fear we cry: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Having cast off sluggish sleep, O my soul, and...

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: ...amendment toward standing show forth unto the Judge, and with fear cry out: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Thou Who by power on high art praised cherubically, and in divine glory receivest worship from angels: receive also us sinners who cry unto Thee with compunction: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Through the intercession of the bodiless hosts, O Lord, send down light upon our souls, and great mercy.

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Having our hearts in the heavens, let us emulate the angelic rank, and with fear let us fall down before the Judge, sending up the triumphal praise: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Not daring to gaze upon Thee, the Cherubim, flying, cry with acclamation the divine hymn of the thrice-holy voice; with whom also we cry:...

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: ...cry, we sinners: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: by the prayers of all Thy saints, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Constrained by the multitude of our transgressions, and not daring to look up to the height of heaven, bowing soul and body, with the angels we cry unto Thee: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God: for the sake of the Mother of God, have mercy on us!

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: Being the Light, O Christ, enlighten me through Thyself: through the intercession of the bodiless hosts, save me.

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆бразова́ти смѣ́юще мы́сленаѧ твоѧ̑
items.english_text: [Lower Outer Binding Board: Contemporary blind-tooled calfskin binding of the first third of the 17th century (dark brown calf leather over bevelled wooden boards). Around the perimeter of the board runs a blind-tooled framework: an outer double-fillet frame and an inner ornamental frame rolled with a Renaissance palmette and foliate roll. The central panel is unadorned, displaying natural age patina, scuffs, surface abrasions, and isolated minor worming. On the left (fore-edge) of the board are preserved the brass catches and leather strap remnants of two original clasps. On the right edge near the lower spine corner are visible the remains of an early paper shelfmark label. The leather is turned in over the inner board edges with neat diagonal mitered folds at the corners.[^299]]
